translations.source: The U.N. also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
translations.reference: UN tún ní ìrètí láti parí ìkówójọ láti ran àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè tó ní ìkọlù global warming lọ́wọ́.
translations.hypothesis: Ajoṣe Agbaye tun nireti pe yoo pari ipari ohun elo lati ran awọn orílẹ̀-èdè tó ní ìlera nitori itanna ayé láti ṣàkóso awọn ipa tó wọ́pọ̀.

translations.source: The money could go toward flood-proof houses, better water management, and crop diversification.
translations.reference: Owó náà lè jẹ́ fún kíkọ́ ilé tágbàrá kò le wọ̀, tí yíò le sàkóso omi dáadáa òhun dídari ohun ọ̀gbìn.
translations.hypothesis: Owo yii le lo fun awọn ile ti o le daabobo lati ma ja, itọju omi ti o dara julọ, ati awọn ọna tuntun ti ṣiṣe awọn ere.

translations.source: Fluke wrote that the efforts by some to drown out women from speaking out about women’s health were unsuccessful.
translations.reference: Fluke ko wipe igbiyanju awon kan lati teri awon obinrin ki won ma ba soro nipa ailera awon obinrin mo lo jasi pabo.
translations.hypothesis: Fluke sọ pe awọn igbero ti diẹ ninu awọn eniyan ṣe lati da awọn obinrin kúrò láti ṣàkóso ọrọ nipa ilera awọn obinrin ko ṣaṣe.

translations.source: She came to this conclusion due to the multitude of positive comments and encouragement sent to her by both female and male individuals urging that contraception medication be considered a medical necessity.
translations.reference: Ó pinu pé nítorí ọ̀pọ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ àti àmoran dídára tí tọkùnrin tọbìrin firánṣẹ́ síi, tí wọ́n wípé kí òògùn tó ń dènà oyún jẹ́ dandan.
translations.hypothesis: Ó sọ ìgbésẹ̀ yìí níwájú pé, nitori ọ̀pọ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ ayẹwọ̀ àti ìdárayí tó wà lójúùn rẹ̀, ti àwọn ènìyàn, àárùn àti ọkùnrin, ti rán fún òun, pé a gbọ́dọ̀ ròpọ̀ nípa ohun tó ṣe pataki ní àwọn ohun eléyí tí a máa n lo láti da ìbááyì.

translations.source: When the fighting ceased after the wounded were transported to the hospital, about 40 of the other remaining inmates stayed in the yard and refused to return to their cells.
translations.reference: Nigba ti ija pari ti awon ti won farapa lo si ile iwosan, bi ogoji awon to seku ni ogba ewon duro si inu ogba ti won si ko jale lati wo inu ewon pada.
translations.hypothesis: Lẹ́yìn tí iṣàkà náà parí, ó sì máa jẹ́ pé àwọn tí wọ́n ṣẹlẹ wà níbi náà wọ́n ti gbé wọ́n lọ sí ilé iwòtí, nípa 40 àwọn ènìyàn miíràn tí wọ́n kò ṣẹlẹ wọ́n tún wà ní inú ìgbàpà náà, wọ́n sì kò fẹ́ padà sínú awọn yàrá wọn.

translations.source: Negotiators tried to rectify the situation, but the prisoners' demands are not clear.
translations.reference: Àwọn tó ń dúnàdùra gbìyànjú láti sàtúnse ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà, ṣùgbón ǹkan tí àwọn ęlẹ́wọ̀n fẹ́ ò yé ni.
translations.hypothesis: Awọn alátàjò gbàgbọ́ pé wọ́n yẹ kí wọ́n ṣaṣe ayẹwọ́ sí ipo náà, ṣùgbọ́n awọn orọ̀ tó wọ jẹ́ àwọn ohun tó ṣe pataki fún awọn ẹlẹ́gbẹ̀rún.

translations.source: Between 10:00-11:00 pm MDT, a fire was started by the inmates in the yard.
translations.reference: Laarin ago 10:00-11:00 ale MDT, awon elewon to wa ninu ogba bere ina kan.
translations.hypothesis: Lẹ́yìn ọ̀rọ̀ 10:00 sí 11:00 ni ọjọ́ kan, awọn aláìtàn ti o wà ní inú ile ìdánìwọ́ náà ṣíṣẹ́ ìgbàgbọ́ kan ní apá ọjà.

translations.source: Soon, officers equipped with riot gear entered the yard and cornered the inmates with tear gas.
translations.reference: Láìpẹ́, àwọnòṣìṣẹ́ tí wọ́n ti ró ni agbára láti kọjú ìjà wọ inú ọgbà, wọn sì muh àwọn ẹlẹwọ̀n pẹlú tajútaj.
translations.hypothesis: Lẹ́yìn náà, àwọn ọmọ-ẹ̀wùrẹ́ tí wọ àwọn ohun èlò fún ìṣàkóso ìṣàkóso wàlé sínú ìgbàpà náà, wọ́n sì da àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n ti gbé níbi náà sí ojú ọ̀na kan, ó sì fi ohun tó máa ń ṣíṣe ìgbàjọ́rán tán wọn.

translations.source: Fire rescue crews eventually doused the fire by 11:35 pm.
translations.reference: Àwọn panápaná pàpà pa ìná ní 11:35 pm.
translations.hypothesis: Awọn ẹgbẹ ajọṣe ti ṣiṣe itọju ọkọ̀ ayọkẹ́ṣe sọ ọkọ̀ ayọkẹ́ṣe na lọ́wọ́ ní orí àgbààrọ̀ 11:35 ni ọ̀sán.

translations.source: After the dam was built in 1963, the seasonal floods that would spread sediment throughout the river were halted.
translations.reference: Lẹ́yìn tí odò náà di kíkó ní 1963, àwọn àgbàrá àkókò tó má ń ta ẹrọ̀fọ̀ ká kiri ló di dídádúró.
translations.hypothesis: Lẹ́yìn tí ìdáná náà ti kọjá ní ọdún 1963, àwọn ìgbàgbá ọ̀na tí a máa ń rí nígbà tí oríṣiríṣi ohun tó wà nínú oró ilẹ̀ yóò sán jùlọ nínu oró náà, wọ́n ti da.

translations.source: This sediment was necessary for creating sandbars and beaches, which served as wildlife habitats.
translations.reference: Àwọn gẹ̀dẹ̀gẹ́dẹ̀ yìí yẹ fún àti se yanrìn abẹ́ omi àti etí òkun èyí tí yí ò jẹ́ ibùgbé àwọn abẹ̀mí.
translations.hypothesis: Ọjà yìí jẹ́ ohun ti o ṣe pataki fun ṣiṣe awọn ibi ti o nira ati awọn orin, eyiti o jẹ́ ibi isọkan fun awọn ẹranko.

translations.source: As a result, two fish species have become extinct, and two others have become endangered, including the humpback chub.
translations.reference: Nítorínà ẹ̀yà ẹja méjì tí di ohun ìgbàgbé,bẹ́ẹ̀ àwọn méjì míràn wà nínú ewu, pẹ̀lú èyí tó suké.
translations.hypothesis: Nitori eyi, awon iru ẹja meji ti ku sẹyin, ati pe awon miiran meji tun nira lati ma wọ, laarin won ni ẹja ti a n pe ni "humpback chub."

translations.source: Although the water level will only rise a few feet after the flood, officials are hoping it will be enough to restore eroded sandbars downstream.
translations.reference: Biotilejepe ibi ti omi naa de a maa ga si leyin iji omi awon ofisa ni ireti pe o ma to lati da awon iyepe to ti ru sita pada si inu omi.
translations.hypothesis: Bii o ti ṣe, ọpọlọpọ awọn ẹẹ́rùn kìí máa ń ṣàgbà sí ìgbà tí o kúre, àwọn àṣajú ti ń ṣàkọ̀wé pé o lè ṣeé dàárá láti dá àwọn ìbùrù ti o ti kúro sí ìgbà tí o kúre.

translations.source: No tsunami warning has been issued, and according to the Jakarta geophysics agency, no tsunami warning will be issued because the quake did not meet the magnitude 6.5 requirement.
translations.reference: Kòsí ìkìlọ̀ fún tsunami, àti gẹ́gẹ́ bí àjọ Jakarta geophysics ṣe sọ́,kòsí ìkìlọ̀ nítorí ilẹ̀ mímì kò dé 6.5.
translations.hypothesis: Ko si ìfọwọ́ṣe ohun ọ̀ṣà ti a fi han, ati pé, gẹgẹ bi ohun ti a sọ ni aṣàájú iṣiro iṣe ilẹ̀ Jakarta, ko yẹ kí a fi ohun ọ̀ṣà kan han, nitori ìṣe náà kò tọ si iwọn ti 6.5.

translations.source: Despite there being no tsunami threat, residents started to panic and began to leave their businesses and homes.
translations.reference: Bótilẹ̀jẹ́ wípé kò sí ìdúnkòkò ilẹ̀ ríru, síbẹ̀ àwọn olùgbé tí ń fòyà, wón dè bẹ̀rẹ̀ síní fi okoòwò àti ilé wọn sílẹ̀.
translations.hypothesis: Bii o ti wa pe ko si ewu ti o le fa awọn ọrọ̀ ọ̀ṣà, awọn olugbe sọ́rọ̀ pẹ̀lú ìbàjẹ́, wọ́n sì bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí láti kúrò ní àwọn iṣẹ́ àti ìlè wọn.

translations.source: Although Winfrey was tearful in her farewell, she made it clear to her fans she will be back.
translations.reference: Lóòótọ́ Winfrey ń sọkún lákòókò ìdágbére rẹ̀, ó sọ s´ di mímọ̀ fáwọn olólùfẹ́ rẹ̀ pé òun padà bọ̀.
translations.hypothesis: Bí Winfrey ń ṣaṣe ìgbà tí ó ń kúrò, ó rírá, ṣùgbọ́n ó sọ fun awọn olùfẹ rẹ̀ pé ó má bọ síbẹ̀.

translations.source: "This is not going to be goodbye. This is the closing of one chapter and the opening of a new one."
translations.reference: “Eyi kii se o di gba. Eyi je ipari abala kan ati ibere titu.”
translations.hypothesis: "Èyí kò ni jẹ́ ìparí. Ìyẹn ni opin ti ọ̀kan ninu awọn ipo, àti bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ọ̀kan tuntun."

translations.source: Final results from Namibian presidential and parliamentary elections have indicated that the incumbent president, Hifikepunye Pohamba, has been reelected by a large margin.
translations.reference: Èsì ìdìbò ààrẹ àti tilé ìgbìmọ̀ asòfin ti sàfihàn wípé ààrẹ̀ tó wà lórí àlééfà Hifikepunye Pohamba náà ni wọ́n tún yàn sípò pẹ̀lú ààlà tó pọ̀.
translations.hypothesis: Awọn abajọto opin ti awọn idibo aṣoju ati awọn àwọn aṣoju ti orílẹ̀-èdè Namibia ti fihan pé Ọládélé, Hifikepunye Pohamba, ti gbejade mọ́lẹ̀bìnrinẹ́.

translations.source: The ruling party, South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO), also retained a majority in the parliamentary elections.
translations.reference: Ẹ̀gbẹ́ tó n dari ìlú Egbe Guusu Iwo Oorun (SWAPO) nílo èyàn púpọ̀ ní ìbò ìgbìmọ̀ àwọn aṣòfin.
translations.hypothesis: Igbimọ ọ̀dún, Ọ̀rọ̀ Àwọn Ènìyàn Ìpínlẹ̀ Ọdọọdun Ìbáji (SWAPO), tun gba ipin ọ̀pọ̀ àkọ́kọ́ nínú ìwájú ìgbimọ̀.

translations.source: Coalition and Afghan troops moved into the area to secure the site and other coalition aircraft have been sent to assist.
translations.reference: ọ̀wọ́ ogun Coalition àti ikọ̀ ogun Afghan wọ agbègbè náà láti gba ààyè àti àwọn ohun ìjagun ojú òfúrufú ti fi rànṣẹ́ láti ṣe ìrànlọ́wọ́.
translations.hypothesis: Agbegbe awọn aṣoju ati awọn ọjọgbọn aṣàfinni ti wọle sínú agbègbè náà láti da ìdánimọ̀ lórí ibi náà, àti pé awọn ọkọ̀ ọ̀wọ̀ ọ̀run miiran ti a ṣifá sí ibi náà láti ràn án lọwọ.

translations.source: The crash occurred high up in mountainous terrain, and is believed to have been the result of hostile fire.
translations.reference: Ijamba naa sele ni ori oke giga, igbagbo si wa wipe ikanra ina ni o se okunfa re.
translations.hypothesis: Ọkọ̀ náà ṣùn ní inú agunádò tó ga, àti pé a gbagbọ pe ohun ti ṣẹlẹ náà jẹ́ àwọn ìgbàgbọ́ tí a ṣàkóso.

translations.source: Efforts to search for the crash site are being met by bad weather and harsh terrain.
translations.reference: Àwọn ìyànjú láti wá ibi ìjàmba náà ni kò ṣeése nítorí ojú ọjọ́ ti ko dára àti ibi gbogbo ilẹ̀ tí ò farajọra.
translations.hypothesis: Awọn igbiyanju lati wa ibi ti ọkọ̀ ọ̀kọ̀ náà ṣubu ni a n fi diẹ sii ṣe, ṣugbọn a ni awọn iṣoro nitori ìwòrún ọlọrọ ti o buru ati àwọn agbegbe ti o nira.

translations.source: The medical charity Mangola, Medecines Sans Frontieres and the World Health Organisation say it is the worst outbreak recorded in the country.
translations.reference: Àwọn ọlọ́re Mangola Medicien Sans Frontieres àti Ile Iṣe Ìlera Ìgbìmọ̀ Àgbáyé, wípé ìbẹ́sílẹ̀ àrùn naa lo buru jù ní gbogbo ìlú.
translations.hypothesis: Ajoṣe iṣoṣi ọrọ-ogun Mangola, Medecines Sans Frontieres, ati Ọjọgbọn Agbaye Ọrọ-ogun sọ pe o jẹ iṣoro ọrọ-ogun ti o buru julọ ti a ti ri ninu orílẹ̀-èdè náà.

translations.source: Spokesman for Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman said: "Angola is heading for its worst ever outbreak and the situation remains very bad in Angola," he said.
translations.reference: Agbẹnusọ fún Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman sọọ́ di mímọ̀ orílẹ̀èdè Angola ń rárí wọ àkókò àjàkálẹ̀ tó burú jù tí ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ yìí sì burú jáì ní Angol.
translations.hypothesis: Aṣoju Médecins Sans Frontières, Richard Veerman, sọ pé: "Angola n lọ sí ọna ìwàdìje àrùn ti o buru jùlọ ti o ti mọ̀, ati pé ipo náà kò yí jẹ́ kìíkan ní Angola."

translations.source: The games kicked off at 10:00am with great weather and apart from mid morning drizzle which quickly cleared up, it was a perfect day for 7's rugby.
translations.reference: Àwọn eré náà bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní aago mẹ́wàá òwúrọ̀ pẹ̀lú ojú ọjọ́ tí ó dára yàtọ̀ fún òjò wẹliwẹli tí ó tètè kásẹ̀ nílẹ̀, ó jẹ́ ọjọ́ tó dára fún ìdíje 7's rugby.
translations.hypothesis: Awọn ere na bẹrẹ ní ìgbà 10:00 ọsán, pẹ̀lú ìwòtí ti o dara, àti pé ní àkọkọ ọsán kan, oju ọ̀run náà ṣán, ṣùgbọ́n èyí kò ṣẹ́dá pẹ́, o jẹ́ ọjọ́ kan ti o dara gidi fún ere rugby.

translations.source: Tournament top seeds South Africa started on the right note when they had a comfortable 26 - 00 win against 5th seeded Zambia.
translations.reference: Orile Ede South Africa tii se akopa ninu idije ti o da julo bere pelu aseyori ti o ga nigba ti won bori awon akegbe won lati orile ede Zambia ti o wa ni ori akaba karun pelu 26 - 00.
translations.hypothesis: Agbegbe oríṣun iṣẹju ti orilẹ-ede Afẹẹ́ṣà, ti o ni ipo ti o ga ju gbogbo, bẹ̀rẹ̀ lẹ́yin ìgbà díẹ̀, nítorí pé wọ́n ṣẹ́dá ìṣẹju 26 sí 00 lójú Zambia, ti o ni ipo ti o wa ní ibi kọkọ́ fún.

translations.source: Looking decidedly rusty in the game against their southern sisters, South Africa however steadily improved as the tournament progressed.
translations.reference: Pẹ̀lú pé ó dàbí pé wọn ò mọ̀ọ́ṣé lẹ́gbẹ́ àwọn ẹgbẹ́ wọn lápá guusu, Ilu Afrika alapa guusu túbọ̀ n ṣe dada bí ídíje náà ṣe n lọ.
translations.hypothesis: Ní ìdílé ere kan tí wọ́n ṣere lójúmọ́ awọn obìnrin tó wà ní orílẹ̀-èdè ilẹ̀ àgbègbè ilẹ̀, ìdánimọ̀ South Africa sì ń tàn ká, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ní ìlọpọlọpọ nígbà tí ìṣàjúkọ náà ń lọ.

translations.source: Their disciplined defence, ball handling skills and excellent team work made them stand out and it was clear that this was the team to beat.
translations.reference: Àwọn agbábọ́ọ̀lù dìfẹ́nsì wọn tó mọṣẹ́, ìsọwọ́ gbá bọ́ọ̀lù, àti àjùmọ̀se to gbámúse mún wan dá yàtọ̀, ó sì hàn gbangba pé àwọn ló tó nà.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ náà ní ìṣọ̀kan láti ṣiṣe, wọ́n sì mọ bí o ṣe yẹ kí wọ́n ṣakoso bọọlu, àti pé wọ́n ṣiṣẹ pẹlu ọpọlọpọ. Èyí jẹ́ ohun tí o ṣe kí wọ́n jẹ́ kíkọ síbi, àti pé o jẹ́ ohun tó mọ láti sọ pé ìyà náà ni ẹgbẹ náà tí yẹ kí gbogbo ènìyàn ṣàkàwé.

translations.source: Officials for the city of Amsterdam and the Anne Frank Museum state that the tree is infected with a fungus and poses a public health hazard as they argue that it was in imminent danger of falling over.
translations.reference: Àwọn òsìsé ìlú Amsterdam àti ti Musiomu Anne Frank fi síta wípé igi náà ti kó ààrùn àwọn kòkòrò tí a lè fojúrí tí o si léwu fún ìlera ara ìlú gẹ́gẹ́ bí wọn se se àtẹnumọ́ wípé o lè fa ìjàmbà lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ nípa wíwó lulẹ̀.
translations.hypothesis: Awon aṣaju ti ilu Amsterdam ati Ile-iṣẹju Anne Frank sọ pe ẹranko naa ni aṣọra kan ti o nmu, ati pe o jẹ ipin ipinlẹ kan, nitori pe wọn sọ pe o wa ni ibusi lati ku.

translations.source: It had been scheduled to be cut down on Tuesday, but was saved after an emergency court ruling.
translations.reference: Wọ́n ti jùmọ̀ sọ pé wọ́n ma ge ní ọjọ́ ìṣẹ́gun, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n fipamọ́ lẹ́yìn pàjáwìrì ẹjẹ́ ilé ẹjọ́.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn èrò ti wà ní ìpínlẹ̀ náà, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n ti ṣàlàyé pé kò ní ṣiṣe wọn. Ìgbà náà, a ti ṣeto láti gbé ẹranko náà sọ́kù ní ọjọ́ Ọjúmọ́, ṣùgbọ́n a ṣàlàyé rẹ̀ lẹ́yìn ìgbàsọ̀rọ̀ ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́.

translations.source: All of the cave entrances, which were named "The Seven Sisters", are at least 100 to 250 meters (328 to 820 feet) in diameter.
translations.reference: Gbogbo iwole okuta na, ti won pe ni “Awon Omo Iya Obirin Meje”, fe to mita 100 si 250 (ese 328 to 820).
translations.hypothesis: Gbogbo awọn igbe ori ti awọn inú ilu, ti wọn pe ni "Awọn Ẹgbẹ Mẹta," jẹ ki wọn kere ju 100 si 250 metresu (328 si 820 feeti) ni iwọn.

translations.source: Infrared images show that the temperature variations from night and day show that they are likely caves.
translations.reference: Àwọn àwòrán atọ́ka fi hàn pé àwọn ìwọ́n òtútù àti ooru láti alẹ́ àti òòjọ́ èyí tó sàfihàn pé ó le dàbí ihò.
translations.hypothesis: Awọn àwọn ifọwọṣi infrared nifihan pe awọn iyatọ ninu iwọn otutu ti o wa lati ọjọ oni tabi ọjọ iwọ, jẹ ki a mọ pe wọn jẹ awọn ile.

translations.source: "They are cooler than the surrounding surface in the day and warmer at night.
translations.reference: “Won tutu ju oju ayika ni osan won de lo si ni ale.”
translations.hypothesis: "Wọ́n jẹ́ ọfẹ́ jùlórí lọ sí ipò ilẹ̀ tí ó wà lágunra wọn ní ọjọ́, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n jẹ́ ọfẹ́ gígùn jùlórí lọ ní orí ọjọ́."

translations.source: Their thermal behavior is not as steady as large caves on Earth that often maintain a fairly constant temperature, but it is consistent with these being deep holes in the ground," said Glen Cushing of the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team and of Northern Arizona University located in Flagstaff, Arizona.
translations.reference: “Ìhùwàsí fún gbígbóná kò sẹ dẹ́ẹ́dẹ́ẹ́ bi àwọn ihọ̀ nla lórí ilẹ̀ tí wọn sáábà ní ìwọ̀n òtútù to sẹ dẹ́ẹ́dẹ́ẹ́, sùgbón o wà ní ìbámu pèlá àwọn ihò jínjìn inú ilẹ̀ náà” Glen Cushin ti ìgbìmò Ìwádìá èka èkọ́ nípa ilé ohun awòràwọ̀ (USGS) àti ti ilé èkọ́ gíga Àríwá Arizona ní Flagstaff, Arizona sọ di mímọ̀.
translations.hypothesis: "Iṣẹṣe iwọn otutu wọn kò jẹ pe o tẹriba bi awọn ile iwosan nla ti wa lori ilẹ, eyiti o maa n ṣiṣe iwọn otutu kan ti o tẹriba, ṣugbọn o ṣiṣe ni ọna ti o da mọ awọn ohun ti won jẹ, ti won jẹ awọn ọwọ inu ilẹ," ni Glen Cushing ti Ẹgbẹ Astrogeology ti United States Geological Survey (USGS) ati ti Yuniversity ti Northern Arizona ti wa ni Flagstaff, Arizona, sọ.

translations.source: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope.
translations.reference: Ní ilẹ̀ Faranse, ètò ìdìbò ti di ìrírí tó kéré, àwọn olùdìbò ma ń yara wan sọ́tọ̀ nínú akoto, fi ìwé tó ń sàfihàn olùdíje dunpò wọn sínú àpò ìwé.
translations.hypothesis: Ni orílẹ̀-èdè Faransì, iṣẹ́ ìgbàgbọ́ jẹ́ ọna ti o rọrun: awọn olùgbàgbọ́ ṣíṣe ìdánilọ́wọ́ wọn nínú ọ̀nà kan, kíjú ìwé papọ̀ tó ti ṣàkóso tàbí tó ti da, tó sì fún ìlànà olùgbàgbọ́ tí wọ́n fẹ́ rí lọ sí inú apoti.

translations.source: After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll.
translations.reference: Lẹ́yìn tí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ti ṣàrídájú olùdìbò, olùdìbò a fi ẹnfílópì sínú apoti ìbò a dẹ̀ fọwọ́ sí iwé ìbò.
translations.hypothesis: Lẹ́yìn tí àwọn ọjọwùjọ ṣe àmójúti pé ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ náà jẹ́ ọmọ ẹgbẹ́, ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ náà yó ìwójú kan sínú apoti ìgbàpà, kí o sì kọ́ àkọsílẹ́ sí ìwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́.

translations.source: French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings.
translations.reference: Òfin ìdìbò ilẹ́ Faranse se àgbéjáde ìlànà òfin lóní danda.
translations.hypothesis: Ofin ìgbàwọle Faranse ṣíṣẹ láti ṣàkóso àwọn iṣẹlẹ tí ó wà nínu ìgbàwọle ní ọna tí ó jẹ́ kíkún.

translations.source: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters.
translations.reference: Lati ọdun 1988, apoti idibo gbọdọ jẹ eyi ti o seeri fun awọn oludibo ati awọn oluworan lati ri wipe ko si apo iwe kankan ninu apoti ki idibo to bẹrẹ ati wipe ko si afikun apo iwe kankan yatọsi ti awọn oludibo ti a lu lonte.
translations.hypothesis: Lati ọdun 1988, awọn apoti idibo gbọdọ jẹ abẹ, nitorí pé àwọn olùṣùnṣùn ati àwọn alábòjúlé nílò láti rí pé kò sí ohun kan tó wà nínú apoti náà níbẹ̀ tí ìgbàgbọ́ bẹ̀rẹ̀, àti pé kò ní yí ohun kan sínú apoti náà, àfi awọn leta tí àwọn olùṣùnṣùn tí wọ́n ti ká àti wọ́n tí fẹ́ràn.

translations.source: Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
translations.reference: Àwọn olùkópa lè fi aṣojú wọ́n ránṣẹ́ láti jẹ́rìsí gbogbo ètò náà. Ní alẹ́, àwọ́n tó fi ara wọ́n sílẹ̀ ka àwọn ìbò pẹ̀lú àbójútó tó le, tó sì tẹ̀lé àwọn ìlànà kan pàtó.
translations.hypothesis: Awọn olùṣùnṣùn le rán àwọn aṣoju wọlé láti rí gbogbo opin ní ìgbàgbọ́ ìpààmọ́. Lórí ọjọ́, àwọn wọlé ti a ṣe gige ni a ka nipasẹ awọn olùṣẹ, pẹ̀lú ìdàgbàsókè tó tó, nígbà tí a n tẹle awọn ìforukọsilẹ̀ kan.

translations.source: ASUS Eee PC, earlier launched world-wide for cost-saving and functionality factors, became a hot topic in 2007 Taipei IT Month.
translations.reference: Ero ayarabiasa ti ASUS Eee, eyi ti won gbejade kaakiri agbaye fun edinwo ati isepataki amulo, di gbajugbaja ni osu Taipei IT ti 2007.
translations.hypothesis: ASUS Eee PC, ti a ṣeto fun ọrọ-ọrọ ayé ni ibẹrẹ, fun idi ti ṣiṣe awọn ohun ti o ni owo kekere ati ṣiṣe awọn iṣẹ, di ohun ti gbogbo eniyan n sọrọ nipa ni Oṣù IT ti Taipei ni ọdun 2007.

translations.source: But the consumer market on laptop computer will be radically varied and changed after ASUS was awarded in the 2007 Taiwan Sustainable Award by Executive Yuan of the Republic of China.
translations.reference: Sùgbọ́n ìtajà àwọn oníbàárà lórí ẹ̀rọ ayára bí àṣá lápútọọ̀pù yóó yàtọ̀ lọ́pọ̀ lẹ́yìn tí ASUS gba àmì ẹ̀yẹ nínú àmì ẹ̀yẹ Taiwan Sustainable Award by Executive Yuan ti ilẹ̀ olómìnira China.
translations.hypothesis: Ṣugbọn ọja fun awọn alákààbà lórí kómputà alágbádì yà yà yóò yan ju ati ríráyé lẹ́yìn tí ASUS gba ẹ̀bùn "Taiwan Sustainable Award" ni ọdun 2007 láti ẹgbẹ́ "Executive Yuan" ti Orílẹ̀-èdè Ṣáínà.

translations.source: The station's web site describes the show as "old school radio theater with a new and outrageous geeky spin!"
translations.reference: Ojú ọ̀pọ́ weebu ibùdó náà sàpéjúwẹ àfíhàn náà gẹ́gẹ́ bi “ ìtàgé rédíò ohun àtíjò pèlú àyípadà titun àti ìtìjú tó kù dìé kááto.”
translations.hypothesis: Oju opo wẹẹbu ti ile itẹle naa ṣapejúwe ere naa bi "ere ere radio ti o da lori awọn ere ti o wà tẹlẹ, ṣugbọn pẹ̀lú ọrọ-ọrọ tuntun ati awọn iṣe ti o ṣeto."

translations.source: In its early days, the show was featured solely at the long-running internet radio site TogiNet Radio, a site focused on talk radio.
translations.reference: Lówùrọ́ọ̀ ọjọ́ ayé rẹ̀, ètò náà sàfihàn ìlò ìtàkùn rádíò TogiNet Radio, ìtàkùn tó fojúsun ọ̀rọ̀ orí rádíò.

translations.source: In late 2015, TogiNet established AstroNet Radio as a subsidiary station.
translations.reference: Ní ìparí 2015, Togineti dá Rédíò Astroneti sílẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí àyè rédíò àbẹ́.
translations.hypothesis: Lẹ́yìn ọdún 2015, ni òpọ̀ àkọkọ, TogiNet ṣí AstroNet Radio sí níbi kan tí ó jẹ́ apakan ti iṣẹ́ wọn.

translations.source: The show originally featured amateur voice actors, local to East Texas.
translations.reference: Ni atileba ere naa lo awon elere ohun to n kose, to wa ni agbegbe Tegsasi Ila Oru.
translations.hypothesis: Iṣẹlẹ náà ní àwọn èròkò tó ń ṣàlàyéwé, tí wọ́n jẹ́ àwọn ènìyàn tó wà ní agbègbé Ìpínlẹ̀ Texas.

translations.source: Widespread looting reportedly continued overnight, as law enforcement officers were not present on Bishkek's streets.
translations.reference: Wọ́n ròyìn pé olè jíjà tó gbàlú tún ń kiri ní gbogbo òru tòrípé àwọn agbófinró ò sí ní títì Bishkek.
translations.hypothesis: Ìparí ìfarabalé ti o yàrá jù wà ní ìgbà ọ̀sán, nitori pé àwọn ọjọgbọn aṣọ̀kan kò wà lórí ọ̀nà kọọkan ní Bishkek.

translations.source: Bishkek was described as sinking into a state of "anarchy" by one observer, as gangs of people roamed the streets and plundered stores of consumer goods.
translations.reference: Wọn ṣàpèjúwé Bishkek gẹ́gẹ́ bí èyí tó ti wọ inú ipò tí “gbogbo rẹ́ ti dàrú nígbàtí kò sí olórí” nípa olùwòran kan, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn tí rìn káàkiri ojú títì tí wọ́n sí jí àwọn ọjà àwọn ènìyàn.
translations.hypothesis: Ibi ti Bishkek wa ni a ṣe apejọ pe o nṣe si ipo "aṣara," gẹgẹ bii ohun ti ọkan ninu awon eniyan ti o ri i ṣe sọ, nitori awọn ẹgbẹ awọn eniyan ti n lọ lori awọn agbalagba, ki wọn si ma n gba awọn ohun ti a le ra ni awọn ile itaja.

translations.source: Several Bishkek residents blamed protesters from the south for the lawlessness.
translations.reference: Ọpọlọpọ awọn olugbe Bishkek gbe ẹbin ainibowo fun ofin ru awọn olufehonuhan lati apa iha guusu.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ọjà ti Bishkek sọ pe awọn ẹlẹgbẹẹ́ ti n ṣiṣe iṣẹ́ ìgbàgbọ́ ti wa lati guusu ni wọn ni orisun ìṣẹ́ àìtọju ọ̀rọ̀.

translations.source: South Africa have defeated the All Blacks (New Zealand) in a rugby union Tri Nations match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.
translations.reference: Ilẹ̀ South Africa ti sẹ́gun àwọn aláwọ̀ dúdú gbogbo (New Zealand) nínú ẹgbẹ́ rugby orílẹ̀ mẹ́ta ní pápá ìseré Royal Bafokeng nílẹ̀ Rustenburg nilẹ̀ South Africa.
translations.hypothesis: Orílẹ-ẹde Afirika Agbegbe ti ṣẹgun awọn ẹgbẹ "All Blacks" (orílẹ-ẹde Niu Silandi) ninu iṣaaju kan ti awọn awokọta rugby "Tri Nations" ti o waye ni Ìtajà Royal Bafokeng ni ilu Rustenburg, orílẹ-ẹde Afirika Agbegbe.

translations.source: The final score was a one-point victory, 21 to 20, ending the All Blacks' 15 game winning streak.
translations.reference: Esi asekagba je ti ibori pelu ayo kan don do, mokanlelogun si ogun, to o fi opin si aifi-idiremi meedogun lera-lera ti All Blacks’.
translations.hypothesis: Iṣẹ́-ọkọ̀ kan ti pari, ati pe All Blacks gba 20 awọn ipo, lakooṣe awọn ọkọ̀ wọn gba 21 awọn ipo. Iṣẹ́ náà sì jẹ́ ìgbà tí All Blacks kò mọ ìṣẹ́ kan lọwọ ní ọdún 15.

translations.source: For the Springboks, it ended a five-match losing streak.
translations.reference: Fun awon Springbooki, o so ipadanu ere-marun seyin dopin.
translations.hypothesis: Fun awọn Springboks, o jẹ ki wọn ṣàjí ìgbà tí wọ́n ti ṣọra awọn ere mẹ́rín.

translations.source: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.
translations.reference: Ere ti wọn gbẹyin gba ni fun awọn All Black to ti gbegba oroke ni ọsẹ meji to kọja.
translations.hypothesis: Ìyàfi oríṣun ni náà fún "All Blacks," ti ó ti gba ifọkọyọ náà ni ọsẹ méjì sẹyin.

translations.source: The final match of the series will take place at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, when the Springboks play Australia.
translations.reference: ifesewonse asekagba eto yio waye ni Papa isere Ellis ni Ilu johannesburg ni ose tin b, nigba ti Springboks gba pelu Australi.
translations.hypothesis: Iṣẹju ipari ti awọn ere naa yóò wáyé ní Ellis Park ní Johannesburg ni ọsù kékeré tiwọn, nígbà tí Springboks ó máa ń ṣere pẹ̀lú Australia.

translations.source: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday.
translations.reference: Iji to le die mi apa iwo orun Montana ni ago 10:08 aaro lojo Aje.
translations.hypothesis: Iparun ilẹ̀ kekere kan ṣiṣe ni agbaye Montana ti orilẹ-ede Amẹrika ni ọjọ Isinú, ní àsàájú ọ̀sán 10.

translations.source: No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center.
translations.reference: Kò sí ìjàbọ̀ ìjàmbá lẹsẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ ́nípasẹ̀ United States Geological Survey (USGS) àti Ibùdó National Earthquake.
translations.hypothesis: Ti owo ti a san si Ile-iṣiro Ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà (USGS) ati Ile-iṣiro Ase Awọsan ti orile-ede naa, ko si awọn iroyin ti o wa tọ, ti o nso, ti o nsojupe pe ohun kan ti farapa.

translations.source: The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.
translations.reference: Isele ile riri naa kojopo si bii km ogun (maili meedogun) ni apa ariwa-ariwa ila oorun Dilioni ati bi km marundinlogorin (maili ogoji) guusu Butte.

translations.source: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.
translations.reference: Wàhálà bird flu sí àwa ènìyàn, H5N1, ti gba àrídájú pé o ti koran pẹ́pẹ́yẹ, tí wọ́n rí ní ọjọ́ ajé, ní marshland ní tò sí Lyon ní ìlà òòrùn France.
translations.hypothesis: Agbara ọrọ̀ ọwúrọ̀ ti o le pa awọn ènìyàn, ti a mọ nipá H5N1, ti jẹri pe o ti ja ọwúrọ̀ ọlẹ́ kan ti o ku, ti a ri lẹ́yìn ni ọjọ́ Ìdundun, nínu agbègbè ilẹ̀ àwọ̀ kan tó wà lágun níbi Lyon, ní apá guusu orílẹ̀-èdè Faransé.

translations.source: France is the seventh country in the European Union to suffer this virus; following Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy.
translations.reference: Ilẹ̀ Faransé ní orílèèdè èkeje nínú àjọ ìsọ̀kan ilẹ̀ Europu tí yíò farakásá kòkòrò yìí lẹ́yìn ilẹ̀ Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece àti Italy.
translations.hypothesis: Orílẹ̀-èdè Faranṣi jẹ orílẹ̀-èdè mẹta lórí orílẹ̀-èdè méjìdò kan ti orilẹ-èdè Yuroopu ti o ni ìlera yí; lẹ́yìn orílẹ̀-èdè Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece, àti Italy.

translations.source: Suspected cases of H5N1 in Croatia and Denmark remain unconfirmed.
translations.reference: Wọn kò sií ì sàfimúnlẹ̀ ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ afurasí H5N1 ní Croatia àti Denmark.
translations.hypothesis: Awon ìwọn ọrọ ti a ti gbo wipe o ni H5N1 ni Croatia ati Denmark, won ko mọ titi di opin.

translations.source: Chambers had sued God for "widespread death, destruction and terrorization of millions upon millions of the Earth's inhabitants."
translations.reference: Chambers ti pé Ọlọ́run lẹ́jọ̀ fún “àjàkálẹ̀ ikú, ìparun àti ìfúngun mọ́ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn èèyàn tó wà nínú ay.”
translations.hypothesis: Chambers ti sọ̀rọ̀ fún ọmọdé ti Olórun nítorí "ìkú, ìfarada, àti ìgbàgbá ti o kópa láti mú ìwàdà ọpọlọpọ àwọn ènìyàn lórí ilẹ̀ yí."

translations.source: Chambers, an agnostic, argues that his lawsuit is "frivolous" and "anybody can sue anybody."
translations.reference: Chambers tó jẹ́ onígberaga jiyàn pé ẹ̀sùn òhun kò lẹ́sẹ̀ ńlẹ̀ àti pé ẹnikẹ́ni lè gbé ẹni tó bá wùú relé ẹjọ́.
translations.hypothesis: Chambers, ti o jẹ ọ̀kan ti o ko mọboye, sọ pe iṣẹ́ ìgbàgbọ́ tí ó ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ jẹ́ "àìtọ́" ati pé "ẹnikan le sọ ìgbàgbọ́ fún ẹnikẹni."

translations.source: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."
translations.reference: Ìtàn tí Casmille Saint--Saens ṣàgbékalè rẹ nínú eré ìtàgé Faransé, jẹ tí ayé rè kún fún ìfẹ́ àwọn ògùn àti Japan .
translations.hypothesis: Itan ti a ṣafihan nínú ere orin Faranse náà, ti Camille Saint-Saens ṣe, jẹ itan ọmọ ẹlẹ́wùrọ kan "ti oríṣi rẹ̀ ti ṣókòkò nípa ìfẹ́ fún ohun tó jẹ́ àwọn ohun ọjà àti orílẹ̀-èdè Japan."

translations.source: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.
translations.reference: Fún ìdí èyí, àwọn òṣèré ń mu tábà líle lórí eré ìtàgé áti pe eré ìtàgé tìkalárarẹ̀ ń gba àwọn olùwòran ní ìmòràn láti se bẹ́ẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́.
translations.hypothesis: Nitori eyi, awon agbekaaye nfi igbo cannabis lo lori ipamọ, ati pe ile itàn náà sókè àwọn ènìyàn ti o wa ní inú rẹ̀ láti gba pọ̀ sí i.

translations.source: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.
translations.reference: Agbẹnusọ ti Newt Gingrich tẹ́lẹ̀, Gómìnà Texas Rich Perry àti ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ ìjọba lóbìnrin Michele Bachmann parí ipò hẹrin, ìkarùn, àti ìkẹfà.
translations.hypothesis: Agbà ti o ti jẹ Alakoso Ile Aṣofin, Newt Gingrich, Gọvẹnọ̀ ti Texas, Rick Perry, ati ọmọ Ile Aṣofin, Michele Bachmann, pari ni ipo keje, kẹta, ati mẹfa, ni orukọ wọn.

translations.source: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.
translations.reference: Lẹ́yìn tí àbájáde wolé, Girinigiṣi sa Santorumu ṣùgbọ́n ìbáwí ló ní fún Romini, tí wọ́n torí ti ẹ ṣe Ìpolówó burúkú fún Gingiriṣi ní ìpínlẹ̀ Iowa.
translations.hypothesis: Lẹ́yìn tí àwọn abajọto wà sẹ, Gingrich s'alẹ fún Santorum, ṣùgbọ́n ó ní àwọn èrò burú fún Romney, pé àwọn ìwàpà ìgbàgbọ́ ti a ṣàlàyé lórí rẹ̀ ní Iowa lójúmọ́ Gingrich.

translations.source: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.
translations.reference: Perry ṣe àlàyé wípé òhun o ‘padà sí Texas láti ṣe ayèwò àbájáde ifikùnlukùn ẹgbẹ́ lálé òní, pinnu bóyá ìtẹ̀síwájù wà fún mi nínú ìdíje yìí.” Ṣùgbọ́n lẹ́yìn náà o sọ wípé òhun o tesíwájú nínú ìdíje láti figagbága nínú idibò abẹ́lẹ́ ọjọ́ kọkànlélógún oṣù kìíní tí gúúsù Carolina.
translations.hypothesis: Perry sọ pe ó má wá padà sí Texas láti wo awọn abajọto ti ipade ọlọrọ náà tí ó wáyé ni ilọ ni òun, kí ó le mọ bí ó ṣe le tàn yíyàn rẹ̀ síwájú nínú ìjà náà. Ṣùgbọ́n, ó sọ ní ìgbà kan pé ó má bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìjà náà títí, àti pé ó má ṣe ìjà ni ipade ọlọrọ ti South Carolina tí ó má wáyé ni ọjọ 21 Ọwọọba.

translations.source: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
translations.reference: Bachmann, tó borí ìdìbò Ames Straw nínú oọù kẹjọ ti pinnu láti parí ìpolongo rẹ̀.
translations.hypothesis: Bachmann, ti o gba ifọwọṣi ni awọn idibo Ames Straw Poll ni Oṣù Kẹta, ti pinnu lati da opin si iṣẹlẹ ṣiṣiṣẹ rẹ.

translations.source: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.
translations.reference: Wọ́n ti gbé ayàwòrán lọ sí ilé ìtọ́jú UCLA Ronald Reagan, níbi tí ó ti padà jáde láyé.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ̀ṣẹ́ àwọn èrò kan gbé ọmọ ẹni náà lọ sí ile itọju Ronald Reagan ti wa ní UCLA, níbi tí ó kú lẹ́yin.

translations.source: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."
translations.reference: Wọ́n fi tó ni léti pé o kú ni nǹkan bí ọmọ ogún ọdún, Birber sọ pé “ mi ò sí ní ibẹ̀ bẹ́ẹ̀ ni ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ńla-ibi yìí kò ṣe ojú mi kòró, àdúrà mi ńbẹ pẹ̀lú àwọn ẹbí tí olóògbé fi sí ayé.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ̀wọ́ ti ṣàlàyé pé ó jẹ ọmọdé ní àwọn ọdún 20. Ní ọ̀wọ́ ìroyìn kan, Bieber sọ pé: "[B]í mo ko wà níbi náà, tí mo kò si daabobo nínú ìṣẹ́lẹ̀ burú yìí, ìrànṣẹ́ mi àti ìbàjẹ́ mi wà pẹ́lú ẹbí alákòkò náà."

translations.source: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.
translations.reference: Ìtàkùn Ìròyìn ìdárayá tí a mọ̀ sí TMZ jẹ́ kó yé pé àayàwòrán náà dá ọkọ̀ òun dúró lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ kejì Sepulveda Boulevard, ó sì gbìyànjú láti ya àwòránibi ìdánidúró àwọn ọlọ́pàá kí ó tó sọdá sí òdì kejì tí ó sì tẹ̀síwájú, ní èyí tí ó mú kí àwọn ọlọ́pàá òpópónà California tí wọn n ṣe ètò sún kẹrẹ̀ fà kẹrẹ ọkọ dáa dúró kí o padà ní ẹ̀ẹ̀méj.
translations.hypothesis: Oju-irin ayelujara TMZ ti gbe mọ̀ pé olùfọto náà fipamọ ọkọ̀ rẹ̀ lẹ́yìn Sepulveda Boulevard, kíjú ọ̀nà kan, ó sì gbìyànjú láti gba aworan ti aṣàyàn ọlọọjẹ náà ṣaaju ki ó kọjá ọ̀nà náà sílé. Ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà jẹ́ kí ọlọọjẹ ọlọọjẹ ti California Highway Patrol, tí ó ń ṣàkóso ọ̀nà náà, fi gbàsọ́ fún ọ̀kan láti padà sísẹ́, èyí tí ó ṣẹ́kùnṣí ní ọ̀nà náà.

translations.source: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.
translations.reference: Pẹ̀lú gbigba àwọn àmì ẹ̀yẹ méjìdínlógún lójojúmọ́, ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè ti kùnà láti wà lóri tábìlì àmì ẹ̀yẹ.
translations.hypothesis: Nígbà tí awọ́n méjìwún medal nìkan ti wà láti ṣàkóso ní ọjọ kan, ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè kọjá ò ti le gbé medal kan lọ́wọ́.

translations.source: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.
translations.reference: Wọ́n sàfimọ́ àwọn ará ilẹ̀ Netherlands pẹ̀lú Anna Jochemsen tó parí pẹ̀lú ipò kẹsàn án nínú àwọn obìnrin tó ń dúró ní kílàsì super-G lánàá àti Katja Saarinen ti ìlú Finland tó parí pẹ̀lú ipò kẹwàá nínú ètò kanáà.
translations.hypothesis: Wọ́n pẹ̀lú orílẹ̀-èdè Ọlúfẹ́ (Netherlands), níbi tí Anna Jochemsen jẹ́ ọjà kọkọọ́ kọkọ́ ní ìdíje Super-G fún awọn obìnrin tí wọ́n ń dúró, ní àná. Ṣùgbọ́n, orílẹ̀-èdè Fínlándì tun wà níbi, níbi tí Katja Saarinen jẹ́ ọjà kọkọọ́ díẹ̀ ní ìdíje náà náà.

translations.source: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished eleventh in the men's standing Super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.reference: Mitchell Gourley ti ilẹ̀ Australia parí pẹ̀lú ipò kọkànlá nínú àwọn ọkùnrin tó wà nínú ìdíje Super-G. Czech tí Oldrich Jelinek sì parí pẹ̀lú ipò kẹrìndínlógún ìdíje super-G.
translations.hypothesis: Mitchell Gourley ti orile-ede Australia jẹ ọmọ ẹgbẹ ọkọkọ ti o wa ni ibi kọkọọfun ọdọọdún ni agbaju ninu idije Super-G fun awọn ọkunrin. Oldrich Jelinek, ọyawo kan ti orile-ede Czech, jẹ ọmọ ẹgbẹ ọkọkọ ti o wa ni ibi kọkọọfun ọdọọdún ọdọọdún ni agbaju ninu idije Super-G fun awọn ọkunrin ti o n ṣiṣe ni ipo ti o yatọ.

translations.source: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished fifteenth in the men's sitting Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.
translations.reference: Arly Velasquez ti ilẹ̀ Mexico parí nípò karùndínlógún ìjókòó àwọn ọkùnrin Super-G. Adam Hall ti ilẹ̀ New Zealand parí pẹ̀lú ipò kẹsàn án níjòòkó àwọn ọkùnrin Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: Arly Velasquez ti orile-ede Mexico jẹ ọmọ ẹgbẹ ọkọkọ 15 ni agbaju ninu idije Super-G fun awọn ọkunrin ti o n ṣi. Adam Hall ti orile-ede New Zealand jẹ ọmọ ẹgbẹ ọkọkọ 9 ni agbaju ninu idije Super-G fun awọn ọkunrin ti o ń dúró.

translations.source: Poland's men's visually impaired skier Maciej Krezel and guide Anna Ogarzynska finished thirteenth in the Super-G. South Korea's Jong Seork Park finished twenty-fourth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.reference: Ọkùnrin afọ́jú a gùnkè ilẹ̀ Poland Maciej Krezel àti guide Anna Ogarzynska parí pẹ̀lú ipò kẹtàlá nínú ìdíje Super-G. Jong Seork Park ti ilẹ̀ South Korea parí pẹ̀lú ipò mẹ́rìnlélógún nígun àwọn ọkùnrin super-G.
translations.hypothesis: Ọmọkunrin orílẹ̀-èdè Poland ti o ni ìgbàdùn, Maciej Krezel, àti olùrán rẹ̀, Anna Ogarzynska, pari ní ibi kéjọ-kẹẹ̀rin ní agbaye Super-G. Ọmọkunrin orílẹ̀-èdè South Korea, Jong Seork Park, pari ní ibi èrìnlélógún ní agbaye Super-G fun awọn ọmọkunrin ti o n ṣiṣe ní ibi.

translations.source: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.
translations.reference: Àwọn asètò àlááfíà àjọ UN, tí wọ́n dé ìlú Haiti lẹ́yìn ìsẹ̀lẹ̀ ìjì líle ní ọdún 2010, ni wọ́n ti dá lẹ́bi fún títan ààrùn tó bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní etí bèbè àgọ́ àwọn ọmọ ológun ká.
translations.hypothesis: Awon ọmọ ẹgbẹ aabo ti Apapo Agbaye (UN) ti o de ni Haiti lẹyin iyà ti o ku awọn eniyan pupọ ni ọdun 2010, n jẹ ki a ṣere wọn ni ipo pe wọn jẹ ohun ti o fa itantan ara ti o bẹrẹ ninu agbegbe ibi ti awọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ na ti gbe.

translations.source: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
translations.reference: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìwé ìpéjọ́, ìdọ̀tí tí àjọ UN kó jáde ní ọ̀nà tí kó boójú mú fún ìlera, ṣe okùnfà àwọn kòkòrò àrùn tó wọ ibùdó odò Artbonite, ìkan lára èyí tó tóbi jù ní Haiti .
translations.hypothesis: Gẹgẹ́ sí ìgbàwọ́ ti a mu lọ, àwọn ohun èwé ti o wa lẹ́yìn ìgbésí ayé ti Apọ̀sùlẹ̣ (UN) kò jẹ́ ìwàdà pẹ̀lú ọna ti o yẹ, èyí sì jẹ́ kí àwọn ẹranko wọlé sínu ọ̀na ọkọ àgbọ̀ ti ara Artibonite, ọ̀na ọkọ kan lára awọn tó tóbi jùlọ ní Haiti.

translations.source: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
translations.reference: Kí àwọn ológun tó dé, ìlú Haiti kò ì tí kojú ìsòro tí ó jọ́ mọ́ ààrùn yìí láti ọdun 1800.
translations.hypothesis: Bẹ́ẹ̀re si iṣọ̀rọ̀ awọn aṣọ̀, orílẹ̀-èdè Haiti kò ní rí àwọn ìṣọ̀rọ̀ tó wà nípa orísun ilẹ̀ náà láti ọjọ́ 1800.

translations.source: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
translations.reference: Ilẹ́-ẹ̀kọ́ fún òdodo àti ìjọba tiwantiwan ti Haiti ti tọ́ka sí àwọn ìwádìí olómìnira tí ó dá àbá pẹ́ ikọ́ ọmọ ogun ti Nepal fún àlàáfíà ní UN pẹ̀lú àìmọ̀ kó àrùn náà wọ Haiti.
translations.hypothesis: Ipinle Haitian ti ṣe itọsi awọn iwadi ti a ṣe ni ọna rere, eyiti o ṣiṣepe pe agbari aṣàkun UN ti orile-ede Nepal, laisi mọ, ti mu oorun yii wọle si Haiti.

translations.source: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
translations.reference: Danielle Lantagne, tí oh jẹ́ ògbóntarìgì fún UN lórí àìsàn, sọ pé àwọn onílàjà ni ó ṣe e ṣe kí wọn fa àjàkálẹ̀ ná.
translations.hypothesis: Danielle Lantagne, ọmọ ẹgbẹ agba ti Apapo Agbaye (UN) ti o ni itọsi nipa orin-ọrọ yẹn, sọ pe o ṣee ṣe pe awọn ọjọgbọn ti o wa ni ipo alaṣe ni o jẹ ki orin-ọrọ yẹn fa.

translations.source: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.
translations.reference: Hamilton fi idi re mule wipe ile iwosan ile eko giga Howard gba alaisan na wole ni ara pipe.
translations.hypothesis: Hamilton ṣiṣe alaye pé ile-iwosan Howard University gbigba alẹkunrin náà, àti pé ó wà ní ipò rírí nígbà tí ó wà nínú ile-iwosan náà.

translations.source: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.
translations.reference: Aláìsàn náà ti lọ sí ilẹ̀ Nigeria níbiti wọ́n ti ní àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ kòkòrò Èbólà kan ti wáyé.
translations.hypothesis: Alákùkò náà ti lọ sí Naijiria, níbi tí àwọn ìwọn Ebola ti farahan.

translations.source: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
translations.reference: Ile iwosan naa ti tẹle gbogbo ilana lati dena kokoro, wọn ya awọn ti wọn ni kokoro kuro lati ma ba ko ran awọn to ṣẹku.
translations.hypothesis: Iṣọ̀jọba náà ti tẹle awọn ofin ti a ṣeto fun ṣiṣàyẹwo awọn ohun ọjọ́gbọn, pẹ̀lú láti yọ ọmọ ẹgbẹ náà kúrò àwọn ènìyàn mìíràn láti da ìdánimọ̀ pé kò ní yíò jẹ́ kí àwọn ènìyàn mìíràn rí.

translations.source: Before The Simpsons Simon had worked on several shows in various positions.
translations.reference: Látẹ̀yìnwá, Simpsons Simon ti sisẹ́ lórí ọ́pọ́lọpọ́ àwọn àfihàn ní onírúurú ipò.
translations.hypothesis: Bẹ́ẹ̀re si "The Simpsons", Simon ti ṣiṣẹ lórí àwọn ere oniroyin ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn, ní àwọn ipò kékeré.

translations.source: During the 1980s he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.
translations.reference: Ni odun 1980s o kópa ninu awon ere bii Taxi, Cheers ati Ere Traci Ulman.
translations.hypothesis: Lẹ́yìn ọdún 1980, ó ṣiṣẹ lórí àwọn ere televizhon bíi Taxi, Cheers, àti The Tracy Ullman Show.

translations.source: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.
translations.reference: Ní 1989 ó rànwọ́lọ́wọ́ láti ṣe ìdásílẹ̀ The Simpson with Brooks àti Groening, ló jk aṣojú fún gbígba àwọn ẹgbẹ́ àkọ́kọ́ tó ko ètò náà.
translations.hypothesis: Ní ọdun 1989, ó ṣe ìrànṣẹ "The Simpsons" pẹ̀lú Brooks àti Groening, àti pé òun ni ẹni tí ó fẹ́ràn awọn alárinrin akọọlẹ àkọkọ fún ìtàn rẹ̀.

translations.source: Despite leaving the show in 1993 he kept the title of executive producer, and continued to receive tens of millions of dollars every season in royalties.
translations.reference: Pẹ̀lú pé ó kúrò nínú eré náà ni ọdún 1993 orúkọ rẹ̀ sí wà gẹ́gẹ́ bí onígbọ̀wọ́ àgbà, ó sìn ń gba mílíọ̀nù mẹ́wàá dọ́là ní sáà gbogbo nínú ọlạ́.
translations.hypothesis: Bii o kọja lára awon ti o n ṣiṣẹ lẹ́yìn iṣẹ náà ní ọdun 1993, won tún fún un ni orukọ "alajọṣepọ oludaran," ati pe o tún tẹle gba ọpọlọpọ awọn dalọ̀lù, wọ̀le awọn miliọ̀nù, ni gbogbo ọdun.

translations.source: Earlier the Chinese news agency Xinhua reported a plane to be hijacked.
translations.reference: Sáájú, ilé-iṣẹ́ oníròyìn ilẹ̀ China, Xinhua jábọ̀ ọkọ̀ òfuurufú tí a fẹ́ fi ipá gbà.
translations.hypothesis: Ni ibẹru, ajakale-ori iroyin Xinhua ti orilẹ-ede China ṣiṣe ìroyin wipe ọkọ ayọ̀ kan ti ṣere.

translations.source: Later reports then stated the plane received a bomb threat and was diverted back to Afghanistan, landing in Kandahar.
translations.reference: Awon iroyin to gbeyin nigba naa wipe oko oju ofurufu naa gba ihale bombu won de daa pada lo si Afganistani, o de si Kandaha.
translations.hypothesis: Lẹ́yìn náà, awọn ìwàpọ̀ mìíràn sọ pé ọkọ̀ ọ̀wọ́ náà rí ìpọ̀̀ sípaàti àti pé wọ́n ṣíṣe fún ọ láti padà sínú orílẹ̀-èdè Afghanistan, kúrò nínú ilé-ìgbàjọ́ Kandahar.

translations.source: The early reports say the plane was diverted back to Afghanistan after being denied an emergency landing in Ürümqi.
translations.reference: Ìròyìn àárọ̀ ní wọ́n dá ọkọ̀ ojú òfúrufú lọ sí Afghanistan lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n dùn wọ́n ní ìbalẹ̀ pàjáwìrì ní Ürümqi.
translations.hypothesis: Iwe itan awujọ ti ṣiṣẹ lẹ́yìn náà sọ pé ọkọ̀ ọ̀wọ́ náà jáde lọ sí Afghanistan lẹ́yìn tí wọn kò fẹ́ láti jọ̀wọ́ rẹ̀ láti parí ọkọ̀ ọ̀wọ́ ní Ürümqi.

translations.source: Air accidents are common in Iran, which has an aging fleet that is poorly maintained both for civil and military operations.
translations.reference: Ìjàm̀bá ojú òfúrufú ló wọ́pọ̀ ní ilẹ̀ Iran, èyí tó ní ìtàn pípẹ́ fún àìse àbòjútó tó péye fún ìlò ará ìlú àti ológun.
translations.hypothesis: Aaye ọkọ ayọ̀fẹ́ jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀ ti wọ́pọ̀ ní Iran, nígbà tí orílẹ̀-èdé náà ní ọ̀pọ̀ ọkọ ayọ̀fẹ́ àti ọkọ̀ ọ̀jọ̀gbọ́n tó ti wà lórí inú ọdún, àti pé wọn kò ní ṣàkóso wọn lẹ́yìn bí ó ti yẹ kí a ṣe fún ìṣẹ́ ayọ̀fẹ́ àti ìṣẹ́ aṣà.

translations.source: International sanctions have meant that new aircraft cannot be purchased.
translations.reference: Òfin ìfìyàjẹni ilẹ̀ òkèrè ti fi lélẹ̀ pẹ kò gbọdọ̀ sí ríra ọkọ̀ ojú òfurufú tuntun.
translations.hypothesis: Àwọn ìpààmú àgbáyé ti mu ki a kìí tó ọ̀núrọ̀ láti ra awọn ọkọ̀ ọ̀wọ́ ọ̀run tuntun.

translations.source: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and wounded three more.
translations.reference: Níbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọsẹ̀ yìí, ọkọ̀ bàálù abàsíbi ó wùú àwọn ọlọ́pàá sekúpa èèyàn mẹ́ta , nígbàtí àwọn mẹ́tàa min farapa .
translations.hypothesis: Ni ibẹru ọsẹ yii, ọkọ̀ ọ̀wọ̀ ẹlẹ́sin kan ṣubu, ọkàn ènìyàn mẹta ku, àti pé ènìyàn mẹta miiran rí.

translations.source: Last month Iran saw its worst air disaster in years when an airliner heading to Armenia crashed, killing the 168 on board.
translations.reference: Lóṣù tó kọjá, ilẹ̀ Iran fojú winná àjálù ojú afẹ́fẹ́ tó burú jù lọ́dún nígbàtí ọkọ̀ ojú òfúrufú tó ń lọ sí ilẹ̀ Armenia já lulẹ̀, èyí tó sekúpa ènìyàn méjìdínláàdọ́sàn án tó wà nínú rẹ̀.
translations.hypothesis: Oṣù to kọja, orílẹ-ẹde Iran rí ìṣẹ́ràn ọkọ̀ ọ̀fẹ́ ti o buru jùlọ ní ọpọ̀lọpọ̀ ọdún, nígbà tí ọkọ̀ ọ̀fẹ́ kan ti n lọ sí Armenia ṣubu, kií ṣe àwọn ènìyàn 168 tí wọ́n wà lórí ọkọ̀ náà.

translations.source: The same month saw another airliner overrun a runway at Mashhad and strike a wall, killing seventeen.
translations.reference: Ni osu kan naa oko ofurufu miin sa koja oju ona ni Masaadi o de kolu ogiri, awon eyan metadinlogun lo ku.
translations.hypothesis: Ní oṣù náà náà, ọ̀kan lára awọn ọkọ̀ ìgbàjọ ọ̀wọ́ ọ̀run náà tàn ká sí i, wọ́n sì rí i jẹ́ ọwọ́ àdòtí ní Mashhad, èyí sì kórúmọ́ ọkọ́ ọ̀wọ́ ọ̀run máa jù lórí.

translations.source: Aerosmith have cancelled their remaining concerts on their tour.
translations.reference: Aerosmith ti fagilé ìpàdé orin tó kù ní ìrìn àjò.
translations.hypothesis: Aerosmith ti da awọn ere-idẹ ti o wa tẹriba ninu iṣẹju wọn lọ.

translations.source: The rock band was due to tour the United States and Canada until September 16.
translations.reference: Ẹgbé olórin alàriwo ohùn ti jìtá náà tí sétó làti rin Orílẹ̀-èdè Améríkà àti Canada já títí di Ọjọ́ Kẹrìndínlógún Osù Kẹsàn.
translations.hypothesis: Agbegbe orin náà ti ṣetọ́ láti ṣàlàyé ní orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà àti Kánádà titi di ọjọ́ 16 Òwójú.

translations.source: They have cancelled the tour after lead singer Steven Tyler was injured after he fell off stage while performing on August 5.
translations.reference: Wọ́n ti wọ́gilé ìrìnafẹ́ lẹ́yìn tí asájú orin Steven Tyler nífarapa lẹ́yin tó subú lórí ìtàgé lákòókò tó ń seré lọ́jọ́ karùn ún osù kẹjọ.
translations.hypothesis: Wọn ti yọkọ awọn ilọsiwaju ti o ti ṣeto, niwon ti oloye ti ẹgbẹ náà, Steven Tyler, rí iṣeju lẹ́yìn ti o kúrò lórí agbára ní ọjọ 5 Oṣù.

translations.source: Murray lost the first set in a tie break after both men held each and every serve in the set.
translations.reference: Mure pàdánù eré kiní ní eré ìdíje titiipa lẹ́yìn tí àwọn okùnrin náà di gbogbo sefi ní sẹ́ti náà.
translations.hypothesis: Murray kò ṣẹ́ri ìgbà ìmọ̀ akọkọ́ nípa ìṣe àkọkọ́, nígbà tí àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ meji náà sì ṣíṣe ìṣe wọn lórí gbogbo ìgbà tí ìgbà náà ń lọ.

translations.source: Del Potro had the early advantage in the second set, but this too required a tie break after reaching 6-6.
translations.reference: Del Potro ní àfàní láti ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ní ìpín kẹjì, sùgbọn èyí náà pèfún yíyanjú ìfagagbága lẹ̀yín ayo mẹ́fà si mẹ́fà.
translations.hypothesis: Del Potro ni anfani ni ibẹrẹ ipari keji, ṣugbọn ohun na tun nilo fun "tie break" lẹyin ti o de 6-6.

translations.source: Potro received treatment to his shoulder at this point but managed to return to the game.
translations.reference: Potro gba itoju si ejika re nibayi o si gbiyanju lati pada si ori papa.
translations.hypothesis: Ni ìgbà yìí, Potro gba itọju fun ọwọ rẹ̀, ṣugbọn ó ṣí láti padà sínú ere náà.

translations.source: The program started at 8:30 p.m. local time (15.00 UTC).
translations.reference: Eto naa bere ni dede ago mejo abo ale ti ile naa (15.00 UTC).
translations.hypothesis: Iṣẹlẹ náà bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní 8:30 ni ìgbà ilẹ̀ náà (15:00 UTC).

translations.source: Famous singers across the country presented bhajans, or devotional songs, to Shri Shyam's feet.
translations.reference: Awon ogbontarigi olorin kakiri orileede sagbekale bhajans abi orin isin si abe ese Shyam.
translations.hypothesis: Awon agba awon olòwe ti wa ni orílẹ̀-èdè náà sọ awọn orin isẹgun, tabi awọn orin itọju, fun ọmọdé Shí Shyam.

translations.source: Singer Sanju Sharma started the evening, followed by Jai Shankar Choudhary. esented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
translations.reference: Akọrin Sanju Ṣama ló bẹ̀rẹ̀ etò ìrọ̀lẹ́, Jai Ṣanka Ṣudiri ló tẹ́lẹ̀ Jai Sanaka Sandiri naa. Akọrin Raju Kandiwali n kọri tẹ́lẹ̀.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ̀ṣìn, Sanju Sharma, bẹ̀rẹ̀ ọjọ́ náà, ó sì tẹ́lé pẹ̀lú Jai Shankar Choudhary. Choudhary tun ṣàlàyé ayẹyẹ "chhappan bhog bhajan". Ọ̀ṣìn, Raju Khandelwal, wà pípẹ́ rẹ̀.

translations.source: Then, Lakkha Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.
translations.reference: Lẹ́yìn náà, Lakkha Singh ni ó gba ìdarí kíkọ orin bhajans.
translations.hypothesis: Lẹ́yìn náà, Lakkha Singh sọ́rọ̀ nípa ìwà ọmọdé, ó sì jẹ́ olùsọ́ àkọkò nípa awọn orin ìwúrọ náà.

translations.source: 108 plates of Chhappan Bhog (in Hinduism, 56 different edible items, like, sweets, fruits, nuts, dishes etc. which are offered to deity) were served to Baba Shyam.
translations.reference: Àwọn Chhappan Bhog méjìdínláàdọ́fà (ni Hinduism, mẹ́rìndílọ́gọ́ta ọ̀tọ̀tọ̀ ohun tó ṣe é jẹ, bíi súùtì èso, ẹ̀pà, ounjẹ abbl. Tí wọ́n gbé fún àwọn òrìṣà) ni wọ́n gbé fún Baba Shyam.
translations.hypothesis: Ọwọn 108 ẹ̀yìn ti "Chhappan Bhog" (ninu imọlẹ Hindu, ohun elo 56 kan ti o le jẹ, bii awọn ewi, awọn eso, awọn ọgọ, awọn orisun ounjẹ, ati bẹẹ lọ, ti a nṣe fun orishe) ni a fi fún Baba Shyam.

translations.source: Lakkha Singh presented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
translations.reference: Lakkha Singh ti se ìfàkalẹ̀ chhappan bhog bhajan pẹ̀lú. Olórin Raju Khandelwal ló ń kọ́ọ̀wọ́rìn pẹ̀lú rẹ̀.
translations.hypothesis: Lakkha Singh tun ṣe orin "chhappan bhog" naa. Ọ̀kan lára awon olùfẹ́ orin, Raju Khandelwal, wà pẹ́lú rẹ̀.

translations.source: At Thursday's keynote presentation of the Tokyo Game Show, Nintendo president Satoru Iwata unveiled the controller design for the company's new Nintendo Revolution console.
translations.reference: Nínú àgbékalẹ̀ gbòógì àfihàn géèmù ilẹ̀ Tokyo tọjọ́ àlàmísì, ààrẹ ilẹ̀ Nintendo, Satoru Iwata se àfihàn ìsàkóso àwòrán fún iléẹṣẹ́ tuntun Nintendo Revolution.
translations.hypothesis: Ní ìgbàsán ìṣe ti orukọ pataki ti awọn ọjọ Thursaday ni awọn ifihan Tokyo Game, alailẹgbẹ Nintendo, Satoru Iwata, ṣí iṣẹ́ ṣíṣẹ́ fún ohun elo tuntun ti ile-iṣẹ náà, Nintendo Revolution, ki o ṣafihan apẹrẹ ohun elo ti o le lo lati ṣakoso ere.

translations.source: Resembling a television remote, the controller uses two sensors placed near the user's television to triangulate its position in three-dimensional space.
translations.reference: Ó jọ ohun ìdarí ẹ̀rọ amóhùnmáwòrán, ohun tí ẹ ó fi tukọ̀ lo sẹ́ńsọ̀ méjì tí wọ́n gbé sí ẹ̀gbẹ́tẹ̀ifisàn ẹni tí ó ń lòó láti yígun ipo rẹ̀ ni ọnà mẹ́ta ọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ohun tó wà lórí ṣíṣẹ́, bíi ọ̀pọ̀ fún tẹlifisẹn, ṣíṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú àwọn ẹrọ mímọ́ méjì tó wà lágun àwọn olùgbàsókè, láti ṣe àkọkòrò ipò rẹ̀ nínu agbaye méjì-ìdánilọlá.

translations.source: This will allow players to control actions and movements in video games by moving the device through the air.
translations.reference: Èyí máa gba àwọn eléré ìje láàyè láti darí àwọn ìrìnkákiri nínú eré fídíò nípa gbígbé èrọ náà ká nípasẹ̀ afẹ́fẹ. .
translations.hypothesis: Ìyé yì yòò jẹ́ kí awon ère le dákótọ sì iṣe àti ìrìn lóri ere-idẹ́jóṣe, nípa lí ìdásí ohun èléyí lóri òfìn.

translations.source: Giancarlo Fisichella lost control of his car and ended the race very soon after the start.
translations.reference: Jiankalo Fisisela o lè ṣàkóso moto mọ́,ó dẹ̀ mú u kí èrè sísá náà parí lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ tí wọ́n bẹ̀rẹ̀.
translations.hypothesis: Giancarlo Fisichella kò ṣàkóso ọkọ̀ rẹ̀, àti pé ó kójé ìṣere náà lẹ́yìn ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ díẹ̀.

translations.source: His teammate Fernando Alonso was in the lead for most of the race, but ended it right after his pit-stop, probably because a badly tucked right front wheel.
translations.reference: Ọmọ egbẹ́ rẹ̀ Fenando Alonso ló darí fún púpọ̀ nínú ere ìdíjé, ṣùgbọ́n ó parí lẹ́yìn ìdádúro re, bóyá nítorí pé wọn ò fí ojúẹsẹ̀ṣ mọ́tò há dada.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ̀kan lára awọn ẹgbẹ rẹ̀, Fernando Alonso, jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀ nípa agbaye ìdíje náà fún ìgbà díẹ̀, ṣùgbún tó kò tún jẹ́ nípa òpọ̀ àmúṣin, kòsẹ̀ síbẹ̀, ó kòjọ sípa nígbà tí ó ń ṣàkóso ọ̀rọ̀, ó máa ń ṣẹ̀dá pé ohun tó ṣẹlẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ọkan lára awọn wíìlì náà, wíìlì tí ó wà ní apá ọwọ́ ọtún, rí.

translations.source: Michael Schumacher ended his race not long after Alonso, because of the suspension damage in the numerous battles during the race.
translations.reference: Michael Schumacher parí eréje rẹ̀ láìpẹ́ tí Alonso parí nítori ìjàm̀bá ìrọ́kúnlé nínú ọ̀pọ̀ ìjà làkòókò eréje.
translations.hypothesis: Michael Schumacher parun idije rẹ niwon pe ohun ọrọ ti ohun ọja rẹ fa, eyiti o ṣẹlẹ niwon awọn ija ti o ṣere ni awọn wakati ti idije naa.

translations.source: "She’s very cute and sings quite well, too," he said according to a transcript of the news conference.
translations.reference: “Ó lẹ́wà lọ́pọ́, ó tún kọrin dáradára,” ó sọ́ nípa àkọọ́lẹ̀ ìpàdé àwọn oníròyìn.
translations.hypothesis: "Ó dára gan ati pe ó tun ṣẹ́rẹ̀ lẹ́yìn," ó wí, gẹgẹ bii ohun tó wà nínú ìtọsọ́ ìgbàsán.

translations.source: "I was moved every time we did a rehearsal on this, from the bottom of my heart."
translations.reference: “Gbogbo ìgbà tí a bá se ìgbáradì lóri rẹ̀ ni ara mi ma ń dìde látinú ọkàn mi wá.”
translations.hypothesis: "Mo ni ifẹ́ fún ohun gbogbo ti a ṣe ninu awọn ìgbà ti a n ṣe àwọn ere, lati ọna ìrànṣẹ́ mi."

translations.source: Around 3 minutes into the launch, an on-board camera showed numerous pieces of insulation foam break away from the fuel tank.
translations.reference: Nígbàtí yíò fi tó ìṣẹ́jú mẹ́ta ìsàfilọ́lẹ̀, ọ̀kan lára èrò ayàwòrán tó wà nínú ọkọ̀ ti sàfihàn ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ẹyọ fóòmù ìdáàbòòbò tó já kúrò lára ilé ìképosí.
translations.hypothesis: Lẹ́yìn inú díẹ̀ tí ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ohun ọjà bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí i, kamẹẹra tí o wà lárí inú ọkọ̀ náà fihan pé ọ̀pọ̀ ọ̀na ìdáni ọwọ́ ti ṣíṣe láti inú ipò síṣẹ́.

translations.source: However, they are not thought to have caused any damage to the shuttle.
translations.reference: Síbẹ̀síbẹ̀, kò sí ẹ̀ròngbà wípé wọn mú ìdibàjẹ́ bá agbẹ́rù náà.
translations.hypothesis: Sibẹsibẹ, ko ṣee ṣe pe wọn ti ṣẹda eyikeyi iparun si ọkọ ọrọ.

translations.source: NASA's shuttle program chief N. Wayne Hale Jr. said the foam had fallen "after the time we are concerned about."
translations.reference: Aládarí ọkọ̀ alálọbọ̀ ti NASA, N.Wayne Hale Jr. sọ ọ́ di mímọ̀ pé fóòmùn ti jábọ́ “lẹ́yìn ìgbà tí ó se kókó fún wa”.
translations.hypothesis: Alakọ̀ọ̀kan ti awọṣe ọkọ̀ ọ̀run NASA, N. Wayne Hale Jr., sọ pé àwọn ọwọ́ foomu náà ti wọlé "lẹ́yìn ìgbà tó ṣe pataki fún wa."

translations.source: Five minutes into the display a wind starts rolling in, about a minute later, the wind is reaching 70km/h... then the rain comes, but so hard and so large that it slaps your skin like a needle, then hail fell from the sky, people panicking and screaming and running over each other.
translations.reference: Ìṣẹ́jú márùn ún síwájú idán, ìjì bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ni jà, bí ìṣẹ́jú kan si, ìjì náà dé orí àádọ́rin kìlómítà láàrín wákàtí kan…léyìn náà ni òjò bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ni rọ̀ to bẹ́ẹ̀ ti dídún rẹ̀ lára dàbí abẹ́rẹ́, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni yìnyín ń bọ́ láti ojú ọ̀run, gbogbo ẹnìyàn bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ní wá rìrì, wọ́n ń bẹ̀rù, wọ́n ń pariwo, wọ́n sì ń sá gba orí ara wọn.
translations.hypothesis: Lẹ́yìn mẹ́ta ọwọ́rì, ẹ́rin bẹ́rẹ sí n wo, àti pé ní inú ọwọ́rì kan, ẹ́rin náà ti de 70 kilomítà... lẹ́yìn náà, ọwọ́ bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí, ṣùgbọ́n ó jẹ́ láti gbé láti fi ẹwọn rẹ, bíi ọwọ́ àwọn ẹ́rù. Látìgbà náà, àwọ́ ọ̀run bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ṣà, àwọn ènìyàn ríra, ṣùn, wọlé, àti pé wọ́n ń ṣàkòkò sí ara wọn.

translations.source: I lost my sister and her friend, and on my way there were two disabled people in wheelchairs, people just jumping over and pushing them," Armand Versace said.
translations.reference: Mo pàdánù àbúrò mi obìnrin àti ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀, ní ojú ọ̀nà nígbàtí mò ń lọ mo rí àwọn aláàbbọ̀ ara méjì lórí àga, àwọn ènìyàn kàn ti ara wọ́n,” Armand Versace sọ bẹ́ẹ̀.
translations.hypothesis: "Mo padanu ẹranko mi ati ọrẹ rẹ̀, ati nígbà tí mo n wọle, mo ri awọn ènìyàn méjì tí wọ́n ní ìgbàgbọ́, wọ́n jẹ́ awọn alákòkò, àti pé awọn ènìyàn wà níbi náà, wọ́n sì ń sọ wọn lọ́," Armand Versace sọ.

translations.source: NHK also reported that the Kashiwazaki Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata prefecture was operating normally.
translations.reference: NHK ròyìn pe Ilé ìgbìn agbára nukilia Kaṣiwasaki Kariwa ni Nigata kí ń ṣiṣẹ́ dédé tẹ̀lé.
translations.hypothesis: NHK tun ṣàṣeyọri pé ile itanna nukilia Kashiwazaki Kariwa ti wa ni agbegbe Niigata nì wọ́n ṣiṣẹ lẹ́yìn ìṣẹẹ.

translations.source: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported no effects from the earthquake and that the Number 1 and 2 reactors at its Shika nuclear power plant were shut down.
translations.reference: Hokuriku electric power co. jábọ̀ pé kò sí ipa kankan látara ilẹ̀ rírì àti pé àwọn ìsesí kìnní àti ìkejì sí ilé iṣẹ̀ tó ń pèsè agbára apanirun Shika ni wọ́n ti gbé tìpa.
translations.hypothesis: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. sọ pe ko si ipa ti o wa ti o ṣọfọ si ọ̀pọ̀ àti pé awọn erekùṣi nomba 1 àti 2 ni ile-iṣẹ agbọrọsẹ nukilia wọn ti wa ni pipade.

translations.source: It is reported that some 9400 homes in the region are without water and approximately 100 without electricity.
translations.reference: A gba pé àwọm ilé tó tó 9400 ní agbègbè náà wà láìsí omo àti pé àwọn tó tó 100 wà láìsí iná.

translations.source: Some roads have been damaged, railway service interrupted in the affected areas, and the Noto Airport in Ishikawa prefecture remains closed.
translations.reference: Àwọn ọ̀nà kán ti bàjẹ́ wón to dá reluwé dúró níbi tó kàn Papa Ọkọ̀ Ofurufu Noto ní Iṣikawa wà ní títì.
translations.hypothesis: Diẹ ninu awọn ọna ti wa ni paapaa, iṣẹ ti awọn daradara ti wa ni daabobo ni awọn agbegbe ti o ni ipa, ati pe ile-ita ọkọ ayanrin Noto ni agbegbe Ishikawa tun wa ni pipọ.

translations.source: One bomb exploded outside the governor general's office.
translations.reference: Àdó olóró kan dún gbàmù ní ọfíìsi ̀gbogbogbo gómìnà.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ̀kan bomba jẹ́ ẹnu, o si ja lẹ́yìn ọfiisi Alákọ̀ọ̀kan Agbà.

translations.source: Three more bombs exploded near government buildings in a period of two hours.
translations.reference: Boomu mẹ́ta bẹ̀ ní ẹ̀gbẹ́ ilé ìjọba laarin wákàtí méjì.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ̀pọ̀ àkàkà mẹ́ẹ́ fa sinu ọ̀nà níbi tí àwọn èdó ilé ìjọba wà, láàrin àwọn wakati méjì.

translations.source: Some reports put the official death toll at eight, and official reports confirm that up to 30 were injured; but final numbers are not yet known.
translations.reference: Awon iroyin miin wipe bii eyan mejo lo ku, iroyin osise jeri pe o to 30 to sise; sugbon a o tii mo awon onka ipari.
translations.hypothesis: Diẹ ninu awọn ijèsíṣe sọ pe oríṣii ti awọn èèje ti o jẹ ofin jẹ mẹjọ, ati pe awọn ijèsíṣe ofin tun jẹ́ ki a mọ pé ọpọlọpọ awọn èèye, to ọdún méjìdínlọ́gún, rọ. Ṣugbọn, oríṣii ti awọn èèje ti o jẹ opin kò mọ titi di opin.

translations.source: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.
translations.reference: Cyanuric àti melamine ni a rí nínu ìtọ̀ àwọn ohun ọ̀sìn inu ilé tó ti kú lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n jẹ òúnjẹ́ wọ́n tó ti dọ̀tí.
translations.hypothesis: Àwọn ohun eléyan ti o jẹ cyanuric acid ati melamine ni a ri ninu àwọn èwé ọwọ ti awọn ẹranko ti o ku lẹyin ti wọn jẹ awọn ohun idọti ti o ni àìṣe.

translations.source: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.
translations.reference: Àwọn ìsopọ̀ méjì náà siṣẹ́pọ̀ pẹ̀lú ara wọn láti di àwọn kìrísítà tí ó lè dí iṣẹ́ kídìnrín lọ́wọ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn olùsàyẹ̀wò ilẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ fásitì ti wí.
translations.hypothesis: Awọn ohun ríkan méjì wọ̀nyí ṣíṣanṣan pẹ̀lú ara wọn láti ṣàkóso ohun èlẹ́gbin tí ó lè fún ìwà ìṣe ẹkùn. Ìwọlé ìtajà ìlú náà sọ pé, awọn wíwíṣẹ́ náà ti ṣe ìwẹ́rọ̀ yí.

translations.source: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.
translations.reference: Àwọn oníiwàdí ri wíp wọ́n se kírísítà pẹ̀lú ìtọo olóńgbò pẹ̀lú àdàlù melamine àticyanuric acid.
translations.hypothesis: Awọn oniṣeto iwadi wọnyi ṣàkóso awọn kristali ti o ṣiṣẹda ninu omi ẹyin ẹyin, nipá àwọn ohun elo melamine ati cyanuric acid sinu rẹ̀.

translations.source: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
translations.reference: Ẹ̀kún àwọn kristali wọ̀nyí bá ti ìtọ̀ àwọn ẹran ọ̀sìn to kóo nígbàtí a fi wọn wéra pẹ̀lú infrared spectroscopy (FTIR.
translations.hypothesis: Iṣe awọn kristali wọnyi ṣàtúnṣe pẹlu awọn ohun ti a ri ninu omi ara awọn alailẹgbẹ ti o ni ilera, ti a ṣe afiwe nipá ọrọ̀ ìdáni ìṣe ìṣe (FTIR).

translations.source: I don't know if you realize it or not, but most of the goods from Central America came into this country duty-free.
translations.reference: Mi kò mọ̀ bóyá ó yé ọ tàbí kò yé ọ, sùgbọ́n ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ẹrù ni ó dé láti ààrin gbùngbùn America wọ orílèèdè yìí lọ́ọ̀fẹ́.
translations.hypothesis: Mo mọ bí o ṣe mọ tabi ko mọ, ṣùgbọ́n ọ̀pọ̀ ọ̀wọn ọjà ti o wa lati Amẹrika Gunju wọle sínú orílẹ̀-èdè yìí laisi owo itẹlẹ.

translations.source: Yet eighty percent of our goods were taxed through tariffs in Central American countries. we treat you.
translations.reference: Bee kede re, mejo ninu idamewa awon oja wa ni o gba owo ori nipase tarifi ni ilu Amerika aarin, aa wo e san.
translations.hypothesis: Sibẹ́si, ipin ogun ẹ̀rùpẹ́ àwọn ọjà wa jẹ́ àkọkọ́ tí a fi owó kan ní orílẹ̀-èdè Central America. A máa ń ṣàkóso rẹ.

translations.source: That didn't seem to make sense to me; it certainly wasn't fair.
translations.reference: Ìyẹn ò ní ìtunmọ̀ sí mi; dájúdájú kò dára.
translations.hypothesis: Èyí kò dẹ́kun fún mi; kò sí ohun tó yẹ kí a ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀.

translations.source: All I say to people is you treat us the way we treat you.
translations.reference: Ohun gbogbo tí mo má ń sọ fáwọn ènìyàn ni wípé kí o tọ́jú wa bí a se ń tọ́jú rẹ.
translations.hypothesis: Ohun ti mo sọ fun awon eniyan ni pe, o yẹ ki ẹ mu wa ṣe bi mo ṣe mu ẹ.

translations.source: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed into law a bill that bans the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.
translations.reference: Gomina Kalifonia Arnold Schwarzenegger fowosi ofin titun ti o pa leewo lati ya tabi ta ere fidio to ni ijakadi, si awon omo kekere..
translations.hypothesis: Alhaji Arnold Schwarzenegger, Govenọ̀ ti California, ti kọja ọ̀pọ̀lọ̣ kan sí ìjọba tó máa n gbé ìforukọpá láti ṣe ìṣe láti ma ṣe rirọ̀pẹ́ tabi ma fi ẹ̀yà àwọn ere fidio tó ní ìṣoṣo fún ọdún tó kọjá.

translations.source: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.
translations.reference: Àbá náà gba kí wọ́n sa àmì “ọmọ ọdún méjìdínlógún” sí ara eré fọ́ńrán amóhùnmáwòrán ̀ kan tí wọ́n tà ní ìpínlẹ̀ California, kí wọ́n sì ta ọjà wọn fún àwọn ọmọ tí wọn kò ì bàlágà ṣùgbọ́n tí ìjìyà owó ìtanràn tó tó ẹgbẹ̀rún kan dọ́là wà fún.
translations.hypothesis: Ìwọ̀-ẹ̀rọ náà ní àwọn ere fíìmù tí ó ní ìṣòro tí wọ́n fún ni àwọn èèyàn ní ìpínlẹ̀ California láti ṣiṣe àti láti ṣiṣe àkọsílẹ̀ wọn pẹ̀lú àkọsílẹ̀ kan tí ó wà ní "18". Ìwọ̀-ẹ̀rọ náà tún ń ṣàkóso láti ṣe ìdàgbàsókè fún ẹni tó ba fún ọmọdé ní àwọn ere náà, pẹ̀lú owo ìdàgbàsókè ti $1000 fún ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ kọọkan.

translations.source: The Director of Public Prosecutions, Kier Starmer QC, gave a statement this morning announcing the prosecution of both Huhne and Pryce.
translations.reference: Àwọn adarí ìbánirojó Gbogbgbò, Kier Stammer QC, fi ọ̀rọ̀ kan sílẹ̀ ní àárs yìí tí ó ń kéde ìbánirojọ́ ti Huhne àti Pryce.
translations.hypothesis: Alakọ̀ọ̀kan ti aṣiṣẹ́ iṣẹ́ ọ̀dọọdun, Kier Starmer QC, ti ṣàlàyé ni ọjọ́ oni wọ̀nyin, pé a yóò ṣiṣẹ́ lórí iṣẹ́ ọ̀dọọdun fún Huhne àti Pryce.

translations.source: Huhne has resigned and he will be replaced in the Cabinet by Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is expected to take the Business Minister job Davey is vacating.
translations.reference: Hune ti fiwe sile, won de ma fi Ed Dafe MP ropo e ni Igbimo. Nomani Lab MP ni a n reti pe o ma gba ise Minista Isowo ti Dafe ma fi sile.
translations.hypothesis: Huhne ti yé ìgbàgbé, àti pé Ed Davey, ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ àwọn aṣoju, yóò jẹ́ ọmọẹẹ rẹ̀ ní Apẹrẹ Alàákàá. Norman Lamb, ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ àwọn aṣoju, ní ìbàjẹ́ yóò gba ìṣe ti aṣoju iṣẹ́ tí Davey n gbé.

translations.source: Huhne and Pryce are scheduled to appear at the Westminster Magistrates Court on February 16.
translations.reference: A ṣètò fún Huhne àti Pryce láti farahàn níwájú ilé ẹjọ́ májísírètì Westminster ní ọjọ́o kẹrìndínlógún oṣùu kejì.
translations.hypothesis: Huhne ati Pryce ni a ṣeto pe wọn yóò wà ní Ibọlẹ 16 ni Ọkunrin-ìgbà Westminster Magistrates Court.

translations.source: The fatalities were Nicholas Alden, 25, and Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback had been the driver.
translations.reference: Àwọn tí ó kú ní Nikolasi Aldini, márùndínlọ́gbọ̀n, àti Sakari Kudbaaki, mọ́kànlélógún, Kudbaaki ni ó ń wa ọkọ̀.
translations.hypothesis: Awọn ẹni ti o ku ni Nicholas Alden, ọmọ ẹgbọn 25, ati Zachary Cuddeback, ọmọ ẹgbọn 21. Cuddeback ni ọja ti ohun gbigba.

translations.source: Edgar Veguilla received arm and jaw wounds while Kristoffer Schneider was left requiring reconstructive surgery for his face.
translations.reference: Edgar Veguilla gba ọgbẹ́ ní apá ati àgbọ̀ǹ nígbà tí Kristoffer Scheider wà ní ipò tó nílò àtúnsẹ isé abẹ fún ojú rè.
translations.hypothesis: Edgar Veguilla rí ara rẹ̀ lẹ́yin ìgbàjọ̀ kan, bí ó ti ṣe pé Kristoffer Schneider nílò ìṣàgbàgbé àwọn àpẹrẹ ọwọ́ fún ọwọ́ rẹ̀.

translations.source: Uka's weapon failed whilst pointed at a fifth man's head. Schneider has ongoing pain, blindness in one eye, a missing section of skull and a face rebuilt from titanium.
translations.reference: Irinogun Uka rugbá nígbàtí wọ́n kọjú ẹ̀ sórí okùnrin ikarun. Ṣinaida wà nínú ìnira lọ́wọ́, ojú rẹ̀ kan ti fọ́, apá agbári rẹ̀ ti sọnù ati pé apá ojú rẹ̀ kan kikida titaniumu ni wọn fi tún un kọ́.
translations.hypothesis: Ọjà ti Uka ṣí, láìsì ṣíṣe, nígbà tí ó ń ṣíṣe lọ́wọ́ orí ọkunrin mẹrin. Schneider nìkan ṣíṣe, ó ní ìwàlẹ́ ní ọ̀kan lára awọn èèyàn rẹ̀, apakan kan ti orí rẹ̀ ti ràn, àti pé wọ́n ti yí ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ṣe pẹ̀lú àwọn ohun elo ti o jẹ́ titanium.

translations.source: Schneider testified via videolink from a USAF base in his homeland.
translations.reference: Ṣínaida fi ìhá-fídíò jẹ́rí láti ibi ọ̀dọ̀ USAF kan nínú orílèdé rẹ̀.
translations.hypothesis: Schneider sọrọ ni iṣẹṣẹ nipáṣẹ ohunẹlẹ ayelujara lati inu ibi isọkan ti Àfọ̀jùnwọ́ Àwọ̀gbò Amerikà (USAF) ti wa ni orílẹ̀-èdè rẹ̀.

translations.source: Beyond Wednesday's event, Carpanedo competed in two individual races at the Championships.
translations.reference: Kọjá ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ọjọ́rú, Carpanedo kópa nínú ìdíje orísìí méjì níbi ìfigagbága olúbori.
translations.hypothesis: Lẹ́yìn ìṣẹ́lẹ̀ tí o ṣẹlẹ ní ọjọ Wednesday, Carpanedo ṣàpinṣe ní àkọ́kọ́ ọkọ̀ ayọ̀ méjì ní ìṣàyànṣọ́ náà.

translations.source: Her first was the Slalom, where she earned a Did Not Finish in her first run. 36 of the 116 competitors had the same result in that race.
translations.reference: Esi re akoko ni Slalom, ni ibi ti o ti gba esi wipe ko pari idije. Merindinlogoji ninu awon olukopa merindinlogofa ni o ni esi kanna ninu idije naa.
translations.hypothesis: Ọkọkọ rẹ̀ kọkọ jẹ iṣaaju Slalom, níbi tí ó kọjá láìsán ipari ní ìgbà àkọkọ rẹ̀. Àwọn ọjà 36 lára àwọn ọjà 116 tí wọ́n ṣe ìṣaaju náà, wọ́n sì ní èwà tó ń yatọ̀.

translations.source: Her other race, the Giant Slalom, saw her finish in tenth in the women's sitting group with a combined run time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes slower than first place finisher Austrian Claudia Loesch and 1:09.02 minutes slower than the ninth place finisher Gyöngyi Dani of Hungary.
translations.reference: Ó parí ní ipò kẹ́wà ní ẹgbẹ́ ìjóko obinrin ní eré ikeji rẹ̀ Slalomi nla, pẹ̀lú àkọ́kọ́ ìsáré àpapọ̀ ìṣẹ́jú 4:41:30, 2:11:60 èyí tí kò sáré tó onípò kíní Klodia Loeṣi ara Ostria àti ìṣẹ́jú 1:09:02 tí kò yá tó onípò kẹ́san Giyongi Dani ará Ongari.
translations.hypothesis: Iṣẹ́ ìdíje mìíràn rẹ̀, ti o ni orukọ "Giant Slalom", jẹ́ pé ó pari ní ipo kọkọọ́ ní ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn obìnrin tí wọ́n ń ṣiṣẹ́ lára, pẹ̀lú àwọn èrè tí ó ṣiṣẹ́ ní gbogbo ìdíje náà tí ó jẹ́ 4:41.30. Ìṣẹ́ náà kéré ní 2:11.60 mìnítù lọ́wọ́ ọ̀kan tí ó wà ní ipo akọkọọ́, tí ó jẹ́ Claudia Loesch ti Austria, àti 1:09.02 mìnítù lọ́wọ́ ọ̀kan tí ó wà ní ipo kọkọọ́ kọkọọ́, tí ó jẹ́ Gyöngyi Dani ti Hungary.

translations.source: Four skiers in the women's sitting group failed to finish their runs, and 45 of the 117 total skiers in the Giant Slalom failed to rank in the race.
translations.reference: Àwọn afòlókè mẹ́rin nínú ẹgbẹ́ àwọn obìnrin kùnà láti parí àwọn iṣẹ́ wọn, àti márùndínláàdọ́ta nínú mẹ́tàdínlọ́gọ́fà àwọn olùfò nínú ikọ̀ Giant Slalom ló kùnà láti rípò nínú ìdíje.
translations.hypothesis: Mẹ́jọ̀ ọ̀kùnrin kan ti o ṣere skiing ní ìgbà tí awon obinrin wa ní ẹgbẹ́ ti o n ṣere ní àkóso, kò tún jẹ́ ki wọn pari iṣẹ́ wọn, àti pé lára awon ọ̀kùnrin 117 ti o ṣere skiing, méjìdògbọ̀n kan kò tún gba ipo kan nínu ìṣere náà.

translations.source: The Madhya Pradesh Police recovered the stolen laptop and mobile phone.
translations.reference: Awon Olopa Madhya Pradesi ri komputa foonu agbeko ti won ji gba pada.
translations.hypothesis: Àwọn ọlọpọlọ ti ipinlẹ Madhya Pradesh já láti da ohunèló gbigba, iyẹẹsi, àti foonu alagbara tó ti já.

translations.source: Deputy Inspector General D K Arya said, "We have arrested five persons who raped the Swiss woman and recovered her mobile and laptop".
translations.reference: Ìgbákẹjì Ayèwò Gbogbogbò D K Arya sṣ wípé, “ A ti fi pánpé mú àwọn márùn tó fi ipá ba´ obìnrin Swiss náà lòpọ̀ a si ti gba èrọ ìbánisọ̀rọ̀ àti kọ̀mpútà rẹ padà.
translations.hypothesis: Aare Alagbala ti o ni ipo keji, D K Arya, sọ pé, "A ti da ọmọ ẹgbọ̀n mẹ́rín kan ti o ṣere abọ̀ fún obinrin Swiss náà, ati pe a ti gba foonu alagbara rẹ àti komputa rẹ."

translations.source: The accused are named as Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar and Vishnu Kanjar.
translations.reference: Àwọn tí wọ́n fi ẹ̀sùn kan ní orúkọ wọ́n jẹ́ Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar àti Vishnu Kanjar.
translations.hypothesis: Awọn ẹni ti o ni ibiwole ni Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar ati Vishnu Kanjar.

translations.source: Police superintendent Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused appeared in court with covered faces.
translations.reference: Ọ̀ga Olópa wípé àwọn boju ẹlẹ́wọ̀n wá sí ilé ẹjọ́.
translations.hypothesis: Alakoso ọ̀pọlọ, Chandra Shekhar Solanki, sọ pé àwọn ọ̀jọ̀kọ̀ rẹ fún ìgbàwí wọ́n bo oju wọn nígbà tí wọ́n wà ní inú ibọ̀lẹ̀.

translations.source: Although three people were inside the house when the car impacted it, none of them were hurt.
translations.reference: Biotilejepe àwọn èyàn wà nílé náà nígbàtí mọ́́tò kọlù, kò sí kan nínú wọn tó ṣiṣe.
translations.hypothesis: Bii o ti ṣẹ, ọkọọkan ninu awon ti o wa ninu ile na ko ṣiṣe, botíji, kò sí ohun tó ba wọn.

translations.source: However, the driver sustained serious injuries to the head.
translations.reference: Sugbon, awako sese sori gidi.
translations.hypothesis: Sibẹ́si, ọ̀kùda náà gbé ìṣòro tóòpẹ́ lórí orí rẹ̀.

translations.source: The road where the crash happened was temporarily closed while emergency services freed the driver from the red Audi TT.
translations.reference: Wọn ti ọpọpọna ti ijamba naa ti ṣẹlẹ ni titipa fun gba diẹ nigbati awọn oṣiṣẹ pajawiri gbiyanju lati yọ awakọ naa kuro ninu ọkọ Audi TT pupa.
translations.hypothesis: Ọna tó ní ìṣẹ́ ajakale náà jẹ́ ìgbà díẹ̀ fọwọ́ sí, nígbà tí àwọn ọjà abájìdéní ń ṣiṣẹ́ láti ṣaṣe ọkọ̀ àgbà tí ó wà nínú ọkọ̀ Audi TT alawọ̀ dàadá.

translations.source: He was initially hospitalised in the James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.
translations.reference: Ọkùnrin náà kọ́kọ́ wà ní ilé ìwòsàn James Paget ní ìlú ńlá Great Yarmouth.
translations.hypothesis: O ni ṣiṣẹẹ́ ni ibi iwe ilẹ́hìn, ti orukọ rẹ̀ jẹ́ James Paget, ti o wà ní Great Yarmouth.

translations.source: He was subsequently relocated to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.
translations.reference: Wọ́n padà gbé lọ sí ilé ìwòsàn Addenbrooke tí ó wà ní Cambridge.
translations.hypothesis: O digba kan, won gbe e lọ sí ọmọ-ẹgbẹ ile-iwosan Addenbrooke's ti wa ní Cambridge.

translations.source: Adekoya has since been in Edinburgh Sheriff Court charged with murdering her son.
translations.reference: Adékọ̀yà ti wà ní ilé ẹjọ́ Edinburg pẹ́lù ẹ̀sùn pé ó pa ọmọ rẹ̀.
translations.hypothesis: Adekoya ti wa ni Ibọlẹ Alákòòkò Edinburgh, nibiti wọn ti fi ẹnu kan pe o ṣe èwù ọmọ rẹ̀.

translations.source: She is in custody pending indictment and trial, but any eyewitness evidence may be tainted because her image has been widely published.
translations.reference: Ó wà ní àhámọ́ títí dí àkókò ìgbẹ́jọ́ àti ìdájọ́, àmọ́ ó se é se kí wọ́n tọwọ́ bọ ẹ̀rí nítorí pé wọ́n ti gbé àwòrán rẹ̀ kiri jù.
translations.hypothesis: Ó wà nínu ibi gbigba ọmọdé, nígbà tí ó ń jirọ fun ìgbàwí pé yóò máa nífẹ̀ẹ́ rẹ̀, ṣùgbún tó ṣe pataki pé ohun ti a rí nílé ìwájú rẹ̀ le máa ń ṣìṣe ìrànlọwọ nitori aworan rẹ̀ ti jáde láti fọwọ́ sí gbogbo ibi.

translations.source: This is common practice elsewhere in the UK but Scottish justice works differently and courts have viewed publication of photos as potentially prejudicial.
translations.reference: Èyí lọ̀pọ̀ ohun tí wọ́n má ń se ní US àmọ́ ìdàjọ́ ilẹ̀ Scottish siṣẹ́ yàtọ̀ àti wípé ilé ẹjọ́ má ń ka àwọn àwòrán tí wọ́n bá gbé síta bí ohun tó lè fa ẹlẹ́yàmẹ̀yà.
translations.hypothesis: Ìyèyí yì jẹ́ ọ̀nà iṣẹ̀ aṣaajù nípa àwọn ìbùrùkùrẹ̀ bíi yìì nínu diẹ́ sìì gbogbo orile-èdè UK, ṣùgbọ́n iṣẹ́ ọdún Scotland ṣiṣẹ dábí àti pe àwọn iṣọ̀ kan ti rí ìdárà àwọn fọtò bíi yìì bí àkósí ti o lè fá ìbọ́rọ̀.

translations.source: Professor Pamela Ferguson of the University of Dundee notes "journalists do seem to be walking a dangerous line if publishing photos etc of suspects."
translations.reference: Omowe Pamela Fegusini tí Ilé Ẹ̀kọ́ Gíga Dondi wipe erékéré ní awon oníròyìn tó n ya àwòrán àwọn tí a fẹ̀sùn kàn, n ṣe.”
translations.hypothesis: Profeseesi Pamela Ferguson ti Yunifasiti Dundee sọ pé, "awọn olùfẹ́ ìroyè wọ́n máa ń ṣiṣẹ́ lórí ọna tí ó le ṣẹ̀dá ìbàjé, nítorí pé wọ́n máa ń ṣíṣẹ́ àwọn fọto àti ohun èke miiran ti awọn ẹni tí wọ́n ń ṣọ̀kan."

translations.source: Crown Office, which is in overall charge of prosecutions, has indicated to journalists that no further comment will be made at least until indictment.
translations.reference: Crown Office, ọ́fíísì tó wà nídìí ìbániṣẹjọ́, ti ṣàfihàn rẹ̀ fún àwọn oníròyìn pé òhun kò ní fèsì kankan mọ títí dìgbà ìdájọ́.
translations.hypothesis: Ofisi Crown, ti o ni apẹrẹ iṣakoso ti awọn ìgbàgbé, ti ṣàlàyé fún awọn olùjọ̀wó pé kò yẹ kí wọn ṣe ìtọsọna miiran, o daju, titi di ìgbà tó wọ́pọ̀.

translations.source: The document, according to the leak, will refer to the borders dispute, which Palestine wants based on the borders before the 1967 Mideast War.
translations.reference: Àwọn àkọọ́lẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ó ti se jẹ jáde, ni ó ma tọ́ka sí ìfànfà ẹnubodè, léyìí tí ilẹ̀ Palestine fẹ́ níbàámun pẹ̀lú bí ibodè se wà sáájú oogun Mideast lọ́dún 1967.
translations.hypothesis: Agbegbe naa, gẹgẹ bii awọn ohun ti o tu silẹ, yoo ṣàkọwe iṣoro ti awọn ipari, eyiti Palestine fẹ ṣe lilo awọn ipari ti o wa ṣaaju ogun ti Middle East ti 1967.

translations.source: Other topics covered reportedly include the future state of Jerusalem which is sacred to both nations and the Jordan Valley issue.
translations.reference: Ara awon akori ti eto naa dale lori ni oro ojo iwaju ile olominira ti Jerrusalemu ti o se koko si orile ede mejeeji ati ti oro petele Jordani.
translations.hypothesis: Awọn ọ̀pọ̀ àkọsílẹ́ miíràn tó ṣe pataki, gẹgẹ bii ìwàdà ti Ilu Jerusalem, tí ó jẹ́ ipò̀lẹ̀ fún àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè méjì, àti ọ̀rọ̀ nínú agbègbè Jordan Valley, náà, wọ́n tún ti yan.

translations.source: Israel demands an ongoing military presence in the valley for ten years once an agreement is signed while the PA agrees to leave such presence only for five years.
translations.reference: Isreli bere fun isoju omo ogun ni petele naa fun odun mewa ni kete ti won pa ti kowesile nigba naa PA gba pe ohun ma fi isoju naa le fun odun marun nikan.
